title: Model training method, data processing method and device based on quantum computing
abstract: The invention discloses a model training method based on quantum computing and a data processing method and device. The method is applied to an intelligent agent comprising an initial world model and an initial network model, the initial network model comprises an initial strategy model and an initial evaluation model, and the initial world model and the initial network model are quantum neural network models formed by quantum circuits. Comprising the following steps: training an initial world model by using a first data set to obtain a target world model; inputting the second data set into a target world model to obtain a third data set; according to the target data set, the maximum entropy reinforcement learning SAC algorithm is utilized to train the initial network model to obtain a target network model, the target data set comprises part of trajectory data in the third data set, and the initial strategy model maps the state of the environment to the action according to the strategy, and the initial evaluation model evaluates the action output by the initial strategy model. The method can improve the efficiency of model training and reduce the calculation amount of model training.

title: Method and device for generating crystal atom coordinates through quantum circuit, product and medium
abstract: The invention provides a method and device for generating coordinates of atoms in a crystal based on a quantum circuit, a product and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of materials and quantum artificial intelligence. According to the method, the Fouli rotation RX gate, the Fouli rotation RY gate and the Fouli rotation RZ gate placed in the quantum circuit are in one-to-one correspondence with the coordinates of each atom of the crystal on the x-axis, the y-axis and the z-axis respectively, so that all structural information of the crystal is obtained, the calculation resource and time cost are greatly reduced, and the calculation efficiency is improved. The quantum chip and the electronic chip can work cooperatively, and the quantum chip and the electronic chip have wide application prospects in the field of materials.

title: Modified TiO2 composite photocatalyst, preparation method thereof and application of modified TiO2 composite photocatalyst in photocatalytic reduction of Cr (VI)
abstract: The invention discloses a modified TiO2 composite photocatalyst as well as a preparation method and application thereof in photocatalytic reduction of Cr (VI), the composite photocatalyst comprises a carrier TiO2 nanosheet and beta-AgVO3 quantum dots grown on the TiO2 nanosheet, and the TiO2 nanosheet and beta-AgVO3 form a direct Z-type heterojunction structure; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving TiCl4 in an organic solvent, and adding water for hydrothermal reaction to obtain a TiO2 nanosheet; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dispersing TiO2 nanosheets in an AgNO3 solution, and dropwise adding NH4VO3 to obtain the TiO2 modified composite photocatalyst. A direct Z-type heterojunction is formed by beta-AgVO3 and TiO2, so that on the basis of keeping the oxidation-reduction performance of TiO2, the compounding of photo-induced electrons and holes is effectively inhibited, and the utilization rate of light is improved, thereby obtaining efficient photocatalytic activity and efficiently realizing reduction of Cr (VI).

title: [100] OR [110] ALIGNED, SEMICONDUCTOR-BASED, LARGE-AREA, FLEXIBLE, ELECTRONIC DEVICES
abstract: Novel articles and methods to fabricate the same resulting in flexible, large-area, [100] or [110] textured, semiconductor-based, electronic devices are disclosed. Potential applications of resulting articles are in areas of photovoltaic devices, flat-panel displays, thermophotovoltaic devices, ferroelectric devices, light emitting diode devices,, computer hard disc drive devices, magnetoresistance based devices, photoluminescence based devices, non-volatile memory devices, dielectric devices, thermoelectric devices and quantum dot laser devices.

title: Low-complexity signal detection method for MIMO FBMC-OQAM (Multiple Input Multiple Output Filter Bank Multicarrier Offset-QAM) system
abstract: The invention discloses a low-complexity signal detection method for an MIMO FBMC-OQAM (Multiple Input Multiple Output Filter Bank Multicarrier Offset-QAM) system. According to the method, channel matrix characteristics are combined with a list sphere detection algorithm; QR decomposition is carried out on an equivalent channel matrix subjected to imaginary and real separation, and the internal interference of the MIMO FBMC-OQAM system is completely eliminated through utilization of obtained unitary matrix orthogonal characteristics; signals are detected through adoption of the list sphere detection algorithm, and a candidate solution vector list is generated through a Grover quantum search algorithm; and a likelihood ratio is solved through utilization of soft information carried in the list, thereby obtaining bit-level output. According to the method, the problem that in the MIMO FBMC-OQAM system, high-order modulation complexity is relatively high is effectively solved through adoption of the Grover quantum search algorithm; the computing complexity is reduced to a certain degree; and the good detection performance is ensured.

title: Quantum streaming
abstract: Quantum safe quantum streaming between a first endpoint device 106a and second endpoint device 106b via a server of a quantum cloud platform 102. At the first endpoint, a data item is split into a plurality of data shards, the data shards are encrypted using a first cryptographic key shared between the first and second endpoint, a first plurality of secure channels 110a are established with the server using a second cryptographic key shared between the first endpoint and the server and the encrypted shards are transmitted towards the second endpoint via the server over the secure channels. At the server, encrypted data shards of a data item are received, the server securely stores the encrypted data shards in a quantum cloud platform secure storage, responding to the second endpoint logging onto the quantum cloud platform, a second plurality of secure channels 110b are established with the second endpoint using a third cryptographic key shared between the second endpoint and server. The encrypted data shards are retrieved from secure storage, transmitted over the second plurality of secure channels to the second endpoint device. The second endpoint decrypts the data shards using the first cryptographic key to reconstruct the data item.

title: Quantum communication implementation method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract: The invention provides a quantum communication implementation method and device based on a quantum channel, electronic equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product, and relates to the field of quantum computers, in particular to the technical field of quantum communication. According to the implementation scheme, at least one coded quantum state which is obtained through initialization and is in one-to-one correspondence with at least one piece of to-be-transmitted data is obtained; iteratively executing the following operations for multiple times to enable the probability of successful measurement when the at least one coded quantum state is measured through the corresponding measurement operator to meet a preset condition: determining the at least one measurement operator for measuring the at least one coded quantum state to enable the probability of successful measurement to be maximum; determining at least one new encoded quantum state such that the probability of success of the measurement is maximized; and performing fine tuning on the at least one new coding quantum state based on a preset disturbance parameter, and determining at least one coded quantum state and at least one measurement operator obtained after the iterative operation.

title: UNIAXIALLY STRAINED QUANTUM WELL DEVICE AND METHOD OF MAKING SAME
abstract: A planar or non-planar quantum well device and a method of forming the quantum well device. The device includes: a buffer region comprising a large band gap material; a uniaxially strained quantum well channel region on the buffer region; an upper barrier region comprising a large band gap material on the quantum well channel region; a gate dielectric on the quantum well channel region; a gate electrode on the gate dielectric; and recessed source and drain regions at respective sides of the gate electrode, the source and drain regions including a junction material having a lattice constant different from a lattice constant of a material of the buffer region. Preferably, the buffer region comprises a Si1-xGex material, and the junction material comprises one of a Si1-yGey material where y is larger than x, or pure germanium, or tin germanium.

title: Real time detecting single electron spinning state method
abstract: The present invention relates to a method which can detect the autogiration state of a single electron in real time. When the occurrence of a Zeeman break of the energy level of a quantum point caused by an outside magnetic field or the energy level of a quantum point is relative to the tunneling through rate among the electrodes, the autogiration information which is taken by the single electron is contacted with the stagnant time on the quantum point when the single electron passes through the quantum point. The autogiration state of the electron can be distinguished through designing an appropriate single electron detector and adjusting the noise level of the detector. The detector is anticipated to work with higher frequency; therefore the information in real time of the autogiration state on the quantum point can be presented. The device has important and potential application in the aspect of quantum information processing, so the needed condition can be completely realized in the current experimental condition.

title: ATOM BEAM GENERATION DEVICE, PHYSICAL PACKAGE, OPTICAL LATTICE CLOCK PHYSICAL PACKAGE, ATOMIC CLOCK PHYSICAL PACKAGE, ATOMIC INTERFEROMETER PHYSICAL PACKAGE, QUANTUM INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE PHYSICAL PACKAGE, AND PHYSICAL PACKAGE SYSTEM
abstract: An atomic oven (40) includes a cartridge (200) and a main body (220). The cartridge (200) includes: a holder (202) that accommodates an atom source; and a capillary nozzle (204). The main body (220) includes: a housing (226) in which the cartridge (200) is installed; a button heater (228); an access opening (222a) for removing the cartridge (200) from the main body (220) and placing the cartridge into the main body (220), the access opening (222a) being provided on the atmosphere side, which is outside the main body (220); and a passage from the access opening (222a) to the housing (226). The cartridge (200) is inserted into the main body (220) through the access opening (222a) and is installed in the housing (226). The atom source is heated by the button heater (228), whereby atomic gas generated from the atom source is emitted as an atom beam to the vacuum side, which is outside the main body (220).

title: Methods of medical imaging using quantum dots
abstract: A method for identifying cells of a living subject in vivo includes delivering a plurality of optical nanoparticles to the cells, optically imaging the optical nanoparticles, and identifying the cells of a living subject from an image and/or spectrum of the optical nanoparticles.

title: Metal platinum (II) and palladium (II) complexes, organic light emitting devices and display or lighting devices
abstract: The invention provides a metal platinum (II) and palladium (II) complex, an organic light-emitting device and a display or lighting device, and the structure of the metal platinum (II) and palladium (II) complex is as shown in the following formula (I). The cyclometalated platinum (II) and palladium (II) complex based on a tetradentate ligand has relatively strong rigidity, can effectively inhibit non-radiative transition generated by molecular vibration, and can be applied to the field of organic light-emitting devices, such as organic light-emitting devices, organic light-emitting devices, organic light-emitting devices, organic light-emitting devices, organic light-emitting devices, organic light-emitting devices, organic light-emitting devices, organic light-emitting devices and the like. The quantum efficiency and the luminous intensity are relatively high. Meanwhile, the tetradentate phosphorescent metal complex disclosed by the invention is a novel parent nucleus structure, and a series of efficient phosphorescent metal platinum complexes can be developed. The material has an excellent application prospect in the fields of OLED display, illumination and the like, especially in the field of light-emitting layer materials.

title: Multi-functional chalcogenide electronic devices having gain
abstract: Multi-functional electronic switching and current control device comprising a chalcogenide material. The devices include a load terminal, a reference terminal and a control terminal. Application of a control signal to the control terminal permits the device to function in one or more of the following modes reversibly: (1) a gain mode in which gain is induced in the current passing between the load and reference terminals; (2) a conductivity modulation mode in which the conductivity of the chalcogenide material between the load and reference terminals is modulated; (3) a current modulation mode in which the current or current density between the load and reference terminals is modulated; and/or (4) a threshold modulation mode in which the voltage required to switch the chalcogenide material between the load and reference terminals from a resistive state to a conductive state is modulated. The devices may be used as interconnection devices or signal providing devices in circuits and networks.

title: Method and system for generating optical lattice by modulating Airy beam through digital mask
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of optics, and discloses a method and a system for generating an optical lattice by modulating an Airy beam through a digital mask, a spatial light modulator is used for loading and generating pure phase distribution of the digital mask to modulate the Airy beam to obtain modulated light, and the modulated light is filtered and focused to generate the optical lattice of a target geometric structure; optical lattices with different geometric structures are obtained by changing the digital mask function # imgabs0 #, the initial optical field distribution # imgabs1 # of the Airy beam modulated by the digital mask is represented as # imgabs2 # in a cylindrical coordinate system, and the digital mask function # imgabs3 # is a spatial distribution function of discrete numbers; according to the invention, the artificially controllable optical lattice can be generated by only one laser beam, the dynamic regulation and control of the special optical lattice with a complex shape can be realized under the condition of not changing an optical path, the geometric structure and the spatial ductility of the optical lattice are controllable, and the method has a wide application prospect in the fields of light capture, quantum simulation and the like.

title: ION TRAP WITH REDUCED RADIO FREQUENCY (RF) CURRENTS USING MULTIPLE FEED PORTS
abstract: Various embodiments provide ion traps (100) or systems comprising ion traps that comprise a trapping portion (110) and a radio frequency (RF) border electrode (120) bounding the trapping portion. The RF border electrode comprises or is in electrical communication with a plurality of feed ports (130A, 130B). In an example embodiment, the ion trap (300) comprises a plurality of unit cells (305A-Q) each comprising a respective trapping portion (310), a respective RF border electrode (320) bounding the respective trapping portion, and a respective feed port (330A-Q) of the plurality of feed ports.

title: ION CHAIN MOTIONAL MODE MEASUREMENT BY FAST SCAN WITH MAXIMUM WEIGHT MATCHING METHOD
abstract: A method of performing a computational process using a quantum computer includes measuring a coupling strength of each trapped ion in an ion chain and each motional mode of the ion chain, wherein the trapped ions comprises first trapped ions that are addressable by laser beams, and second trapped ions that are not addressable by laser beams, computing a first map of the first trapped ions to the motional modes, wherein the motional mode comprises first motional modes that are allocated by the first map and second motional modes that are unallocated by the first map, measuring frequencies of the first motional modes, computing a second map of the first trapped ions to the second motional modes, measuring frequencies of the second motional modes, and outputting the measured frequencies of the motional modes, to be used for computing a pulse to be applied to the ion chain.

title: STRUCTURE AND FORMING METHOD OF SINGLE CRYSTAL SILICON QUANTUM THIN WIRE
abstract: PURPOSE:To manufacture a pillar type quantum thin wire having a constant shape with high reproducibility, by using single crystal silicon as material, and constituting a pillar structure wherein the section is circular or elliptical or polygonal, and the sectional area is smaller than or equal to a specified value. CONSTITUTION:A silicon substrate 1 is etched through an etching window 4 in first mask material 3 formed on a silicon substrate 1, thereby exposing etching side surfaces 5. Second mask material 6 is formed on the etching side surfaces 5, and the first mask material 3 is patterned. The silicon substrate 1 is etched through the part where the first mask material 3 is eliminated. Then the silicon substrate 1 is thermally oxidized. Thereby a single crystal silicon quantum thin wire 9 having a pillar structure which stands straight on the silicon substrate can be uniformly formed with high reproducibility. In this case, the section of the single crystal silicon quantum thin wire may be circular or elliptical or polygonal, and the sectional area is set to be 1000nm<2> or smaller.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR MULTI CORE FIBER QUANTUM KEY GENERATION AND TRANSMISSION
abstract: A quantum key generation system including two photon detector units, two photon entanglement chains extending between the two photon detector units, and a plurality of multicore fiber links each including at least two non-uniform cores structurally configured to provide non-uniform photon propagation delay. Each photon entanglement chain includes at least one quantum repeater structurally configured to entangle a pair of photons and first and second terminating quantum memories optically coupled the quantum repeater using the multicore fiber links such that photons received by the first and the second terminating quantum memories are entangled with photons entangled by the quantum repeater. The first and second terminating quantum memories of each of the two photon entanglement chains form first and second cross-chain quantum repeaters, and the first and the second photon detector units are structurally configured to receive the measurable entangled particles generated by the first and second cross-chain quantum repeaters, respectively.

title: Quantum secret communication system applied to 5G power business
abstract: The invention provides a quantum secret communication system applied to 5G power business, and belongs to the technical field of power business quantum secret communication systems. The quantum secret communication system comprises an application server, a quantum security gateway, a quantum security mobile service engine, an exchange cipher machine, a quantum random number generator, a quantum gateway, a 5G base station and a quantum secret key charging module. The first end of the quantum security gateway is connected with one end of the application server; the first end of the quantum security mobile service engine is connected with the second end of the quantum security gateway; the first end of the cipher exchange machine is connected with the second end of the quantum security mobile service engine; the quantum random number generator is connected with the second end of the exchange cipher machine; the quantum gateway is connected with the third end of the cipher exchange machine; one end of the 5G base station is connected with the third end of the quantum security gateway, and the other end of the 5G base station is connected with a plurality of external communication devices; and the quantum key charging module is connected with the fourth end of the quantum security mobile service engine.

title: Method of providing a quantum wire field-effect transistor
abstract: A quantum wire field-effect transistor having at least one, one-dimensional, elongate conducting means (14) provided by at least a first semiconductor layer surrounded by a wider bandgap, second semiconductor layer (12, 13) and extending between source (24) and drain (26) electrodes, and in which there is provided a backgate structure (8, 23) to control conduction in the elongate conducting means. The transistor can be a Single Electron Transistor (SET) wherein two adjacent gate electrodes (16, 18) are disposed over the elongate conducting means to induce a quantum dot (17) therein, and it can be made with the first semiconductor layer material as GaAs and the second semiconductor layer material as A1GaAs. A method of making the transistor involves preferentially growing the elongate conducting means at the bottom of a groove (6) lined with the second semiconductor layer (12).

title: DIFFERENTIALLY STRAINED QUANTUM DOT DEVICES
abstract: Disclosed herein are quantum dot devices, as well as related computing devices and methods. For example, in some embodiments, a quantum dot device may include: a quantum well stack including a quantum well layer; a first gate above the quantum well stack, wherein the first gate includes a first gate metal; and a second gate above the quantum well stack, wherein the second gate includes a second gate metal, and a material structure of the second gate metal is different from a material structure of the first gate metal; wherein the quantum well layer has a first strain under the first gate, a second strain under the second gate, and the first strain is different from the second strain.

title: Motor electromagnetic design method and device based on quantum neural network and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a motor electromagnetic design method and device based on a quantum neural network and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: inputting a permanent magnet structure and battery parameters into an electromagnetic parameter model and a permanent magnet structure model, and obtaining an electromagnetic parameter output layer and a permanent magnet structure output layer; performing quantum entanglement calculation on the electromagnetic parameter output layer and the permanent magnet structure output layer to obtain a comprehensive evaluation function; based on the quantum neural network, learning the influence of random variable fluctuation to obtain a reliability function; performing weighted summation on the comprehensive evaluation function and the reliability function to obtain a target function; and based on the quantum neural network, solving the objective function to obtain an optimal permanent magnet structure and battery parameters. According to the method, the overall performance advantages and disadvantages, the stability and the safety of the motor can be comprehensively considered, the objective function is solved, and the optimal permanent magnet structure and the optimal battery parameters are obtained.

title: Quantum communication networking method and system based on multi-wavelength channel aliasing entangled light source
abstract: The invention discloses a quantum communication networking method and system based on a multi-wavelength channel aliasing entangled light source. The method comprises: generating a plurality of parallel and mutually independent spontaneous nonlinear effects through a multi-pump nonlinear medium, namely constructing a plurality of broadband entangled light sources in the same nonlinear medium, wherein output spectra of the entangled light sources have certain aliasing (such light sources are named as aliasing entangled light sources); performing wavelength channel configuration on the entangledsingle photons by using a relatively mature dense wavelength division multiplexing technology in a classical optical fiber communication system; and constructing a quantum network server independentof each user and distributing the entangled photons of various wavelengths to each user so as to ensure that every two users share at least one pair of independent entangled single photons. The entangled photon sharing can be achieved through wavelength channel natural aliasing and manual configuration, and therefore the quantum communication network which is high in wavelength channel utilizationrate, capable of achieving multi-user arbitrary interconnection and flexible and adjustable in structure is achieved.

title: Semiconductor circuit and operating method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a semiconductor circuit and an operation method thereof. The semiconductor circuit includes a plurality of serial lines. The plurality of serials includes a first serial and a second serial. The first serial comprises a first device unit and a second device unit which are connected in series. The first serial has a weight signal W1. The first device unit has an input signal A. The second device unit has an input signal B. The second serial comprises a third device unit and a fourth device unit which are connected in series. The second serial has a weight signal W2. The third device unit has an input signal. The fourth device unit has an input signal. The output signal of the semiconductor circuit is the sum of the plurality of serial output serial signals. The plurality of output serial signals of the plurality of serial includes a first serial output serial signal and a second serial output serial signal. The output serial signal of the first serial is' W1 * (A AND B) 'or' A AND (W1 * B) '. Output serial signal of a second serial is or

title: QUANTUM COMPUTING MODULE AND METHOD OF MANIPULATION OF QUANTUM PROPAGATION MODES TO PERFORM A QUANTUM COMPUTATION
abstract: The present invention relates to a quantum computing module comprising: - an input (2) comprising a mode separator (15), configured to separate a transverse electric mode TE and a transverse magnetic mode TM of a quantum into two parallel paths, each path being characterized by: · a single-mode waveguide (4), · mode manipulation means (20), including at least first phase variation means (22); - an output (3) including mode combination means (25); where the two parallel paths (5, 10) are distinguished from each other at least because the first path (5) includes: - first transformation means (30) of the transverse magnetic mode TM into transverse electric mode TE located upstream of said manipulation means (20), - second transformation means (32) of the transverse electric mode TM into transverse magnetic mode TM located downstream of said manipulation means (20).

title: QUANTUM FILM PIXELS WITH LOW READOUT NOISE
abstract: Generally discussed herein are imaging devices and corresponding circuitry and methods of using and making the same. An image sensor device may include pixel circuitry, the pixel circuitry comprising a photosensitive material layer, circuitry including first, second, and third electrodes and a storage device, the first electrode on a first surface of the photosensitive material layer and the second and third electrodes on a second surface of the photosensitive material layer, the first surface opposite the second surface, electrical interconnect circuitry electrically coupling the second electrode and the storage device, and a dielectric material situated between the third electrode and the photosensitive material layer.

title: Light emission using quantum dot emitters in a photonic crystal
abstract: Devices and methods of manufacturing; for emitting substantially white light using a photonic crystal are described. The photonic crystal has a lattice of air holes and is made from a substrate containing quantum dots. The substrate is etched with three defects that are optically coupled together so that each emits only certain frequencies of light. In combination, the defects can produce substantially white light. The parameters of the photonic crystal are dimensioned so as to cause the coupling between the defects to produce substantially white light.

title: PUBLIC KEY CERTIFICATE PROGRAM AND ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE PROGRAM
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a public key certificate program which is safe with respect to quantum computers without the need for repetition of a certificate system, and to provide an electronic signature program which is safe with respect to quantum computers, and which does not require parallel synthesis of a certificate system.

SOLUTION: The public key certificate program is for making a computer function as a grid base generator for generating a grid base B of m rows and n columns (m and n are each an integer larger than '0'); a coefficient vector generator for generating first and second coefficient vectors w1, w2of n row; a public key generator for generating norms K1, K2based on the grid base B and first and second coefficient vectors w1, w2and recording the grid base B and norms K1, K2as a public key; and a private key generator for recording either of the first and second coefficient vectors w1, w2as a private key.

title: Quantum network node design based on optical cavity-waveguide-optical cavity
abstract: The invention provides a quantum network node design based on an optical cavity-cut-off waveguide-optical cavity. The design method comprises the steps: firstly defining a structure of the quantum network node design, which comprises a composite optical cavity and a single atom; the whole composite optical cavity is of a ridge-shaped structure and comprises two semi-closed optical cavities of the same structure and waveguides connected with the semi-closed optical cavities. Atoms are located at the middle position in the waveguide; then the size of the quantum network node and the material for manufacturing the design are given, and mode light is adopted as a light source to verify the function of the quantum network node. The quantum network node provided by the invention is novel in design, simple in implementation mode and long in fidelity and de-coherence time, and has a huge application prospect in quantum information, especially in the aspect of light quantum communication.

title: Quantum biogen and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses quantum biogen and a preparation method thereof. The quantum biogen is prepared from the following substances consisting of the following raw material components: 40-50 parts of volcanic mine lava nanometer powder prepared from natural volcanic mine lava, 5-10 parts of Chinese caterpillar fungus powder and 100-150 parts of glacier water. A high-temperature oxygen injection and high and new rheologic engineering technique process is used for natural non-toxic non-crystal volcanic rocks, through mixing with Chinese caterpillar funguses and the glacier water, and through activation in ultrasonic waves driven by an alternating magnetic field for action, a multi-mine solution being high in activity, high in energy state and multifunctional is prepared. The quantum biogen contains 20 or more life-related elements required for human bodies, and trace elements required for human bodies and rich in the quantum biogen promote cell metabolism of the human bodies and improve vitality of the human bodies. The quantum biogen has multiple physiological functions of regulating the immunity, regulating blood fat, blood sugar and blood pressure, improving sleep, strengthening memory, protecting the vision, resisting weariness, resisting mutation, promoting growth and development, and can improve the resistance.

title: Processing method and device for quantum program, storage medium and electronic device
abstract: The invention provides a processing method and a device of a quantum program, a storage medium and an electronic device, wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a quantum logic gate node of the quantum program as a current designated node; Wherein the quantum logic gate of the currently designated node is a single quantum logic gate; Acquiring a next quantum logic gate node adjacent to the current designated node as a current node to be processed; According to the attribute of the operation gate of the current node to be processed, it is determined whether the merging operation of the operation gate of the current node to be processed and the operation gate of the current node to be specified is performed, and the current node to be processed and the current node to bespecified for the next merging operation are determined. The invention solves the problem that a redundant quantum logic gate is generated when a user creates a quantum program or converts a quantumcircuit, and fills a blank in the related art.

title: Josephson device comprising an oxide superconductor multilayered film
abstract: An oxide superconducting multilayered thin film structure having a laminated layer structure of oxide superconductor thin film layers (1) and non-superconductor thin film layers (2) constituted by a combination of material groups for making strain free interfaces among both thin film layers (1,2). For example, an oxide superconductor multilayered film constituted by a laminated layer structure where thin films (1) of an oxide superconductor represented by the chemical formula of M'Ba2Cu3O7- delta (M'; a rare earth element of Nd, Sm, Eu or the like or an alloy of these, delta ; oxygen depletion amount) and thin films (2) of an oxide represented by the chemical formula of M*Ba2Cu3O7- delta (M*; an element of Pr, Sc or the like or an alloy of these, delta ; oxygen depletion amount) are alternately stacked. The oxide thin films (1, 2) are thin films fabricated by a pulsed laser deposition process or a sputtering process. A Josephson device can be provided by using the multilayered film (1, 2). <IMAGE>

title: Efficient confirmation method and system for color centers in same direction in diamond
abstract: The invention relates to an efficient confirmation method and system for color centers in the same direction in diamond, and the method and system combine fluorescence imaging and optical detection magnetic resonance technologies to achieve the quick and efficient determination of the direction of the NV color center. In actual operation, a large number of color centers in the same direction can be confirmed and screened out through one-time operation according to the process provided by the invention, and the efficiency of quantum information processing and quantum sensing application by utilizing the NV color center array can be greatly improved. The method provided by the invention is also suitable for other color centers (such as SiV and GeV color centers) in diamond and spin defect direction confirmation (such as NCVS and VV color centers in SiC crystals) in other solid crystals, and has universality.

title: Quantum centralized control station communication method and quantum network control center
abstract: The invention discloses a quantum centralized control station communication method and a quantum network control center. The method comprises the steps that the geographical location information and the quantum equipment operation information of the quantum centralized control station are acquired; normal operation of the quantum centralized control station is judged according to the quantum equipment operation information of the quantum centralized control station; if the judgment result is yes, the corresponding point coordinates are determined according to the geographical location information of the quantum centralized control station, and common edges are correspondingly created between the points corresponding to different point coordinates by using the Delaunay triangulation algorithm so as to obtain the corresponding network topology structure; and corresponding communication networking operation is performed on the corresponding quantum centralized control station according tothe network topology structure so as to obtain the corresponding communication network of the network topology structure. According to the technical scheme, the reliability and the stability of the quantum communication network can be effectively enhanced.

title: INFORMATION STORAGE DEVICE EMPLOYING MAGNETIC DOMAIN WALL MOVEMENT, AND METHOD OF MANUFACTURING THE SAME
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an information storage device employing magnetic domain wall movement, and to provide a method of manufacturing the same.

SOLUTION: The information storage device includes: a magnetic layer formed on a substrate, the magnetic layer having many magnetic domains; and a means for applying energy to the magnetic layer for moving magnetic domain walls, wherein the magnetic layer is formed in parallel with the substrate. Many trenches perpendicular to the substrate are formed on the magnetic layer, and portions of a lower surface of the magnetic layer at positions corresponding to the trenches protrude downward from the lower surface of the magnetic layer.

title: PARAMETRIC AMPLIFIER FOR QUBITS
abstract: A parametric traveling wave amplifier (200) is disclosed in which the amplifiers include: a co-planar waveguide, in which the co-planar waveguide includes at least one Josephson junction (210) interrupting a center trace (204) of the co-planar waveguide; and at least one shunt capacitor coupled to the co-planar waveguide, in which each shunt capacitor of the at least one shunt capacitor includes a corresponding superconductor trace (214) extending over an upper surface of the center trace of the co-planar waveguide, and in which a gap separates the superconductor trace from the upper surface of the center trace, and in which the co-planar waveguide including the at least one Josephson junction and the shunt capacitor establish a predefined overall impedance for the traveling wave parametric amplifier.

title: Quantum-Simulations Database and Design Engine for Development of Lithium Batteries
abstract: Methods, systems, and computer programs for selecting electrode materials for a lithium battery are presented. In one embodiment, a method includes an operation for developing models for structural and energy analysis of battery stability, safety, cycling and performance, where the models are developed based on a selection of elements and compositions for the electrode materials. Properties of at least one cell performance parameter are estimated, and a cell discharge rate behavior is calculated. Another operation in the method is provided for selecting an electrode material composition based on the estimated properties and the cell discharge rate behavior. The method operations are performed by a computer system that includes a processor.

title: QUANTUM DOTS, RODS, WIRES, SHEETS, AND RIBBONS, AND USES THEREOF
abstract: Described are ZnxCd1-xSySe1-y/ZnSzSe1-z core/shell nanocrystals, CdTe/CdS/ZnS core/shell/shell nanocrystals, optionally doped Zn(S,Se,Te) nano- and quantum wires, and SnS quantum sheets or ribbons, methods for making the same, and their use in biomedical and photonic applications, such as sensors for analytes in cells and preparation of field effect transistors.

title: Method of forming lateral resonant tunneling devices
abstract: A method of fabricating a quantum well device is presented which includes forming one or more quantum wells 48 by forming an epitaxy mask followed by selective deposition of one or more epitaxial layers. Selective deposition is accomplished by forming an epitaxy mask by sidewall defined masking, followed by epitaxial deposition of one or more layers (e.g. barrier layers 40 and 44 and a quantum layer 42) The epitaxy mask is formed by patterning an e-beam resist layer (e.g. polymethylmethacrylate 36), conformally depositing a glass layer (e.g. SiO2 38) on the resist, anisotropically etching the SiO2, and then removing the e-beam resist layer. The epitaxy mask fabrication technique allows patterning to define geometries that are much smaller than the beam itself and thereby provides the means required to define nanometer dimensioned horizontal (lateral) structures on and within epitaxial layers.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR QUANTUM CIRCUIT SIMULATION
abstract: Embodiments of the invention provide system and method for quantum circuit simulation. The system comprises: a computer system including a processor and a memory communicably coupled to the processor to store data and instructions, wherein the processor is configured to generate an N-qubit system based on a two-dimensional lattice, and each qubit in the N-qubit system comprises a pair of indexes corresponding to a point on the two-dimensional lattice; generate N multi-dimensional tensors, each multi-dimensional tensor corresponding to a qubit and including a dimension which is determined based on the two-dimensional lattice; conduct a gate operation on one or more than one qubit based on the multi-dimensional tensor corresponding to each of the one or more than one qubit; and conduct a measurement on a qubit based on the multi-dimensional tensor corresponding to the qubit.

title: Block chain system, data processing method and device thereof and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a block chain system, a data processing method and device thereof and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of data processing, transmission and encryption. The system comprises a node which is used for being connected with at least one of a consensus node or a common node so as to receive, send and process block chain data, wherein the at least one consensus node is any one of a quantum computer system, a quantum cloud server and a quantum virtual machine; and the common node is any one of a quantum computer system, a quantum cloud server, a quantum virtual machine and a computer system. The balance among throughput, transmission speed and security can be realized, and the application scene requirements of high throughput, low delay and excellent security are met.

title: Estimation method, system and equipment of transmitted signal and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a transmitting signal estimation method, system and device and a storage medium, and the method, system and device are used for an MIMO system, and the estimation method comprises the steps: receiving an external receiving signal; establishing a quantum population; extracting an optimal probability amplitude from the initial probability amplitudes of the quantum chromosomes; updating the initial probability amplitude: obtaining a variation probability amplitude, a mixed probability amplitude and a rotation probability amplitude according to the initial probability amplitude; updating the initial probability amplitude according to the mixed probability amplitude and the rotation probability amplitude, extracting the latest optimal probability amplitude, and adding one to the number of iterations; judging whether the number of iterations reaches an iteration threshold value or not; if yes, obtaining an estimation signal of the transmitted signal according to the latest optimal probability amplitude; if not, continuing to update the initial probability amplitude. According to the method, the probability amplitude of the quantum chromosome is updated by adopting a maximum likelihood detection function algorithm, so the probability amplitude approaches an emission signal and is converged; the problem of high signal estimation complexity is solved, the search frequency is reduced while the performance is ensured, and the signal estimation complexity is reduced.

title: Interconnector performance test assembly
abstract: The invention discloses an interconnection piece performance test assembly, and belongs to the field of quantum chip manufacturing. And a technical scheme. The interconnection piece performance test assembly is provided with a microwave transmission line, a first chip, a second chip and at least two resonant cavities. Resonant cavities and microwave transmission lines are adaptively configured to the first chip and the second chip, and each resonant cavity is also coupled to the microwave transmission line. Wherein a part of the resonant cavity is also interrupted by an interconnection so as to form two parts of elements which are respectively arranged on the first chip and the second chip. Therefore, the evaluation structure can be used for measuring the resonant frequency of each resonant cavity through the microwave transmission line, and evaluating the quality of the interconnection piece according to the measured resonant frequency.

title: Health assessment method based on deep quantum learning
abstract: The invention provides a health assessment method based on depth quantum learning, which comprises the following steps: 1. Constructing an initial depth quantum neural network model; 2, periodically collect vibration signals of that bear and extracting characteristic parameters from the vibration signals; 3, divide that data into a training set and a verification set, training a depth quantum neural network model by use the data of the training set, and evaluating the performance of the model by using the data of the verification set; The collected signals are preprocessed and the processed feature parameters are divided into training data set and testing data set. 4, adjust that parameters of the depth quantum neural network model, and selecte an optimal model for performance evaluation through continuously training the model; 5. Health assessment of bearing by using the model; Through the above steps, the trained deep quantum gods will realize the health evaluation of the bearing, prevent and reduce the occurrence of the equipment failure through the health evaluation of the bearing, minimize the maintenance cost, ensure the safe operation of the equipment and obtain the maximumequipment availability and economic benefits.

title: PROCESS FOR PRODUCING GROUP III NITRIDE SEMICONDUCTOR LIGHT-EMITTING ELEMENT, GROUP III NITRIDE SEMICONDUCTOR LIGHT-EMITTING ELEMENT, AND LAMP
abstract: Disclosed is a process for producing a group III nitride semiconductor light-emitting element that can produce a light-emitting element having excellent internal quantum efficiency and light takeout efficiency. Also disclosed are a group III nitride semiconductor light-emitting element and a lamp. The process comprises an epitaxial step of forming a semiconductor layer (30) so as to cover a main surface (20) of a substrate (2), a mask step of forming a protective film on the semiconductor layer (30), a semiconductor layer removing step of removing the protective film and the semiconductor layer (30) by laser beam irradiation to expose the substrate (2), a grinding step of reducing the thickness of the substrate (2), a polishing step of polishing the substrate (2), a laser beam machining step of providing a machining mark within the substrate (2), and a dividing step of dividing the surface of the substrate (2) into a plurality of light-emitting elements (1) with the divided surface being a rough surface.

title: Simple and reliable method for preparing any Werner state
abstract: The invention discloses a simple and reliable method for preparing any Werner state, comprising a step of preparing an entanglement light source, in which photon pairs are entangled by using laser topump nonlinear crystals to generate a spontaneous parametric down conversion process, and a step of constructing a controllable depolarized channel, in which a completely mixed state is introduced byacting the controllable depolarized channel on one photon. Sandwich-shaped crystals are adopted for the nonlinear crystals and comprise two BBO crystals and a real zero-order half-wave plate disposedbetween the two BBO crystals. The controllable depolarized channel is composed of a Sagnac ring, a complete destructive phase channel and a state superposition portion, the Sagnac ring is of a rectangular structure, and a half-wave plate is disposed between two reflectors thereof; the complete destructive phase channel is composed of two destructive phase crystals and a half-wave plate therebetween; and the state superposition portion comprises a BS. The simple and reliable method is convenient to adjust and high in feasibility, and can be applied to the fields of quantum information processing and quantum communication.

title: Superconductor device interconnect structure
abstract: A method is provided of forming a superconductor device interconnect structure. The method includes forming a first dielectric layer overlying a substrate, and forming a base electrode in the first dielectric layer with the base electrode having a top surface aligned with the top surface of the first dielectric layer. The method further comprises forming a Josephson junction (JJ) over the base electrode, depositing a second dielectric layer over the JJ, the base electrode and the first dielectric layer, and forming a first contact through the second dielectric layer to the base electrode to electrically couple the first contact to a first end of the JJ, and a second contact through the second dielectric layer to a second end of the JJ.

title: FERROMAGNETIC p-TYPE SINGLE CRYSTAL ZINC OXIDE AND METHOD FOR PREPARATION THEREOF
abstract: The present invention provides a single-crystal ZnO thin film having a high ferromagnetic transition temperature. In one aspect of the present invention, the ZnO thin film comprises a ferromagnetic p-type single-crystal zinc oxide including a transition metal element consisting of Mn, and a p-type dopant. In another aspect of the present invention, the thin film comprises a ferromagnetic p-type single-crystal zinc oxide including a transition metal element consisting of Mn, a p-type dopant, and an n-type dopant. The single-crystal zinc oxide material can be applied to quantum computers and high-capacity magnetic-optical recording medium by combining with conventional n-type or p-type transparent electrode ZnO materials or optical fibers, and to powerful information-communication devices or quantum computers as a photoelectric material usable for a wide range from visible light to ultraviolet light. <IMAGE>

title: Liquid crystal display panel, manufacturing method and display device
abstract: The invention mainly relates to the technical field of display, in particular to a liquid crystal display panel, a manufacturing method and a display device, and is used for increasing the display area of the liquid crystal display panel, guaranteeing normal bright and dark state display and raising the transmittance of the liquid crystal display panel. According to the liquid crystal display panel, the manufacturing method and the display device, a quantum dot color film layer is arranged at the side of a first substrate, a polarizer at the side of a second substrate is only reserved, the space between the second substrate and the first substrate is filled with guest-host liquid crystals, and the guest-host liquid crystals have the polarizing effect, so that no polarizer is made at the side of the first substrate; by means of the structure, the display color area is well increased, the problem that normal display cannot be achieved due to existence of the quantum dot color film layer is solved, and the transmittance of the liquid crystal display panel is raised.

title: Nonlinear inductor, Josephson junction, and method for manufacturing and improving performance thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a nonlinear inductor, a Josephson junction and a manufacturing and performance improving method of the Josephson junction, and belongs to the field of quantum chip manufacturing. The Josephson junction comprises a first conductor layer, an insulating layer and a second conductor layer which are sequentially distributed, and wherein the insulating layer is in a crystalline state. The Josephson junction constructed in the form can obtain good interface quality and better current-voltage characteristics provided by the crystalline insulating layer.

title: Preparation method of environment-friendly water-based graphene quantum dot cutting fluid
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of cutting fluid, in particular to a preparation method of environment-friendly water-based graphene quantum dot cutting fluid. The preparation method specifically comprises the following steps: firstly preparing twenty-five layers of graphene quantum dots, then scientifically configuring the graphene quantum dots, a green and non-toxic surfactant, an antirust agent, a corrosion inhibitor, a preservative, a defoaming agent and the like, carrying out testing according to GBT/T6144-2010 quality indexes, and blending stable cutting fluids with different formulas. The lubricating performance of the obtained graphene quantum dot lubricant is improved by 70%, the heat dissipation performance is improved by 50%, the technology is simple and easy to implement, the manpower and material resource cost is greatly saved, and the graphene quantum dot lubricant is suitable for large-scale industrial popularization.

title: Method for generating surface plasmon laser by current pumping
abstract: The invention provides a method for generating surface plasmon laser by current pumping. The method includes the steps: manufacturing heterogenous junctions with materials such as GaAs/AlGaAs by a flat semiconductor process to generate two-dimensional electron gas; preparing a metal nano waveguide with materials such as gold, silver, copper and aluminum on a semiconductor surface to serve as a surface plasmon optical micro-cavity; manufacturing metal electrodes near the micro-cavity and forming semiconductor double quantum dots after electrification; and controlling internal structures of the semiconductor double quantum dots by adjusting the voltage of the metal electrodes, so that current flowing through the semiconductor double quantum dots can generate surface plasmon photons in the waveguide micro-cavity by pumping. The state of the surface plasmon laser can be detected by the current, and the method for generating the surface plasmon laser has the advantages that detection is facilitated, a device has simple features, the structure is compact, the device is easily integrated with an external circuit, and the like.

title: RANDOM NUMBER GENERATOR, RANDOM NUMBER GENERATION METHOD, AND NON-TRANSITORY COMPUTER-READABLE MEDIUM HAVING PROGRAM STORED THEREIN
abstract: The present invention provides a random number generator, random number generation method, and program capable of high-quality random number generation following a desired distribution. A random number generator (1) according to the present invention has: an input reception unit (2) which receives input designating a probability distribution of random numbers; a model generation unit (3) which generates, on the basis of the probability distribution, an Ising model using n (where n is an integer of 2 or more) two-value variables respectively allocated to n partial segments into which a numerical range of the random numbers has been divided; an annealing result acquisition unit (4) which acquires values, of the n two-value variables, which are the execution results of quantum annealing of the Ising model; and a random number output unit (5) which outputs, as random numbers, values included in the partial segments allocated to the two-value variables of which the values obtained as the execution results are prescribed values.

title: QUANTUM DOT SENSITIZED SOLAR CELL
abstract: Photoelectrochemical solar cells (PECs) have been constructed and studied, the cells comprising a photoanode prepared by direct deposition of independently synthesized nanocrystal quantum dots (NQDs) onto a nanocrystalline metal oxide film, aqueous electrolyte and a counter electrode. It has been shown that the light harvesting efficiency (LHE) of the NQD/metal oxide photoanode is significantly enhanced when the NQD surface passivation is changed to a smaller ligand (e.g. butylamine (BA)). In the PEC the use of NQDs with a shorter passivating ligand leads to a significant enhancement in both the electron injection efficiency at the NQD/metal oxide interface and charge collection efficiency at the NQD/electrolyte interface.

title: Two-dimensional extensible superconducting quantum bit structure and cavity mode control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a two-dimensional extensible superconducting quantum bit structure and a cavity mode control method thereof. The two-dimensional extensible superconducting quantum bit structure comprises a superconducting quantum bit chip; the superconducting quantum bit chip comprises a plurality of quantum bits which are distributed in a two-dimensional manner and can be extended; the capacitor part of each quantum bit is provided with at least five arms in two-dimensional distribution; two of the at least five arms in each quantum bit are respectively used for being connected with areading coupling circuit and a control circuit, and the other at least three arms are coupled with the adjacent quantum bits through a coupling cavity. The structure is convenient to extend in a two-dimensional manner, and is suitable for being connected with a signal fan-out board by a conventional flip-chip bonding process or a through-silicon-via technology. When the flip-chip bonding and through-silicon-via processes are not available or eliminated, a plurality of holes are formed in the positions of non-quantum bit lines in the superconducting quantum bit chip; and the superconducting quantum bit chip is bonded to a packaging box body or a circuit board on the basis of the leads of the holes, and therefore, signal crosstalk can be effectively reduced.

title: QUANTUM DOT DEVICES WITH BORON DIELECTRICS
abstract: Disclosed herein are quantum dot devices, as well as related computing devices and methods. For example, in some embodiments, a quantum dot device may include: a quantum well stack including a quantum well layer; and a dielectric layer in contact with the quantum well layer, wherein the dielectric layer includes boron.

title: Semiconductor device structure and fabrication method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a semiconductor device structure and a manufacturing method thereof. The semiconductor device structure includes a substrate; a semiconductor channel suspended over the substrate; a first semiconductor layer surrounding the semiconductor channel; a second semiconductor layer surrounded by the first semiconductor layer; a gate dielectric layer surrounding the second semiconductor layer; and a gate electrode layer surrounding the gate dielectric layer; Wherein a gap width of the first semiconductor layer is smaller than a gap width of the semiconductor channel. The invention simultaneously comprises a two-dimensional hole gas quantum well and a two-position electron gas quantum well, which can greatly improve the mobility of the hole and the electron, improve the current carrying capacity of the N-type field effect transistor and the P-type field effect transistor, and reduce the resistance and the power consumption.

title: TUNNELING DIODE USING GRAPHENE-SILICON QUANTUM DOT HYBRID STRUCTURE AND METHOD FOR PREPARING SAME
abstract: Provided is a tunneling diode comprising a graphene-silicon quantum dot hybrid structure, the tunneling diode having enhanced diode performance and electrical properties by controlling the size of a silicon quantum dot and the doping concentration of graphene. A preferred tunneling diode, according to the present invention, can be used for a diode-based optoelectronic device.

title: Method of forming a transistor having thin doped semiconductor gate
abstract: A method of forming a transistor is disclosed that comprises the step forming a gate insulator layer 12 on an outer surface of the substrate 10. A first gate conductor layer 22 is formed outwardly from the gate insulator layer 12. The first gate conductor layer 22 is extremely thin. Dopants are introduced into the layer 22 to render it conductive by using a diffusion source layer 24. The diffusion source layer 24 is then removed and replaced by a second gate conductor layer 26 having low resistance. The layer 26 can be used to form a T-gate structure 28, a flush gate 30, or a conventional gate structure.

title: MEASUREMENT BASED UNCOMPUTATION FOR QUANTUM CIRCUIT OPTIMIZATION
abstract: Methods and apparatus for optimizing a quantum circuit. In one aspect, a method includes identifying one or more sequences of operations in the quantum circuit that un-compute respective qubits on which the quantum circuit operates; generating an adjusted quantum circuit, comprising, for each identified sequence of operations in the quantum circuit, replacing the sequence of operations with an X basis measurement and a classically-controlled phase correction operation, wherein a result of the X basis measurement acts as a control for the classically-controlled correction phase operation; and executing the adjusted quantum circuit.

title: Architecture for reconfigurable quantum key distribution networks based on entangled photons by wavelength division multiplexing
abstract: A system and method for securing communications over a wave division multiplexing optical network between a plurality of users connected to the network. The system utilizes a primary optical source generator that is either tunable, or capable of generating a plurality of wavebands of different frequencies equal to the sum of wavebands serving individual users of the network to facilitate a key exchange between the individual users of the network using summed wavebands, each of which serving an individual user.

title: Josephson junction using molecular beam epitaxy
abstract: According to various implementations of the invention, a vertical Josephson Junction device may be realized using molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) growth of YBCO and PBCO epitaxial layers in an a-axis crystal orientation. Various implementations of the invention provide improved vertical JJ devices using SiC or LSGO substrates; GaN, AlN, or MgO buffer layers; YBCO or LSGO template layers; YBCO conductive layers and various combinations of barrier layers that include PBCO, NBCO, and DBCO. Such JJ devices are simple to fabricate with wet and dry etching, and allow for superior current flow across the barrier layers.

title: Method for acquiring light speed reduction and super velocity of light in optical fiber
abstract: The invention provides a method to slow down light speed and exceed light speed in the fiber, which introduces laser into the modulator, and then inputs the modulated infrared wavelength laser to the optical isolator, the output optical signal of the optical isolator entering the optical beam splitter, the optical signal from the beam splitter divided into two beams, one reference light signals entering into the optical detector, the majority of optical signal entering into the fiber, and the fiber output installed the detector to measure the output signal, the output signal of the detector being input to computer for processing, and obtaining the measured signal. The invention can not only effectively control the optical signal delay size, but also control the optical transmission speed, and meanwhile, the features of the invention that can easily control the light transmission speed and the optical delay time, brings tremendous technological advantages to the application, such as all-optical delay technology, optical storage, optical cache, and others, and it has very application in laser radar, remote optical communications, quantum information processing, optical gyro, and others.

title: Quantum dots, compositions and composite including the same, and electronic device including the same
abstract: A quantum dot including a nanoparticle template including a first semiconductor nanocrystal including a Group II-VI compound, a quantum well including a second semiconductor nanocrystal disposed on the nanoparticle template, the second semiconductor nanocrystal including a Group IIIA metal excluding aluminum and a Group V element; and a shell comprising a third semiconductor nanocrystal disposed on the quantum well, the third semiconductor nanocrystal including a Group II-VI compound, wherein the quantum dot does not include cadmium, a band gap energy of the second semiconductor nanocrystal is less than a band gap energy of the first semiconductor nanocrystal, the band gap energy of the second semiconductor nanocrystal is less than a band gap energy of the third semiconductor nanocrystal, and the quantum dot includes an additional metal including an alkali metal, an alkaline earth metal, aluminum, iron, cobalt, nickel, copper, zinc, or a combination thereof.

title: Enhancing qubit-qubit interactions between separate chips with spiral resonators
abstract: Various systems and methods are presented regarding utilizing a spiral resonator to enhance coupling between a first inductor loop and a second inductor loop to enable coupling between a first qubit and a second qubit. Operation of the first inductor loop can be controlled by a flux-tunable TCQ coupler, wherein flux-tuning can adjust operation from an OFF state (no coupling between the first qubit and the second qubit) to an ON state (the first qubit and second qubit are coupled). The spiral resonator can be located at the center of, and in the same plane as the loop of the first inductor loop. The spiral resonator can enhance inductive coupling between the first loop inductor and the second loop inductor.

title: DISPLAY MODULE COMPRISING COLOR CONVERSION LAYER FORMED ON SELF-LUMINOUS DEVICE, AND MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREFOR
abstract: Provided is a display module. The display module ncluding a substrate, and a plurality of pixels on the substrate, wherein each of the plurality of pixels includes a first self-luminescence element, a second self-luminescence element, and a third self-luminescence element configured to emit lights of a first wavelength band, respectively, a first color conversion layer configured to be disposed on the first self luminescence element, and comprise a plurality of first quantum dots to absorb the light of the first wavelength emitted from the first self-luminescence element, and emit a light of a second wavelength band and second color conversion layer configured to be disposed the second self luminescence element, and comprise a plurality of second quantum dots to absorb the light of the first wavelength emitted from the second self-luminescence element, and emit a light of a third wavelength band, wherein the first color conversion layer and the second color conversion layer comprise a plurality of foam particles configured to scatter the light emitted from the first self-luminescence element and the light emitted from the second self-luminescence element.

title: Method for determining equivalent critical current and quantum bit frequency
abstract: The invention discloses an equivalent critical current determination method and a quantum bit frequency determination method, and belongs to the technical field of quantum computing. The method comprises the following steps: determining a Josephson junction in the parallel structure as a first Josephson junction, and determining an adjacent Josephson junction as a second Josephson junction; determining the critical current of the superconducting quantum interference device formed by connecting the first Josephson junction and the second Josephson junction in parallel; judging whether a Josephson junction adjacent to the superconducting quantum interference device is included or not; if yes, taking the superconducting quantum interference device as a first Josephson junction and returning to the step of determining an adjacent Josephson junction as a second Josephson junction; and if not, determining the critical current of the superconducting quantum interference device as the equivalent critical current. Based on the scheme of the invention, the critical current of a parallel structure formed by connecting a plurality of Josephson junctions in parallel can be determined.

title: Fabrication of nanomaterial T-gate transistors with charge transfer doping layer
abstract: A field effect transistor including a dielectric layer on a substrate, a nano-structure material (NSM) layer on the dielectric layer, a source electrode and a drain electrode formed on the NSM layer, a gate dielectric formed on at least a portion of the NSM layer between the source electrode and the drain electrode, a T-shaped gate electrode formed between the source electrode and the drain electrode, where the NSM layer forms a channel of the FET, and a doping layer on the NSM layer extending at least from the sidewall of the source electrode to a first sidewall of the gate dielectric, and from a sidewall of the drain electrode to a second sidewall of the gate dielectric.

title: Quantum well transistor with resonant tunneling effect.
abstract: The invention relates to a quantum well transistor with resonant tunnelling effect. In order to improve the gain while precluding charge being stored in the well, composed of a layer (14) with narrow forbidden band and of two barriers (13, 15) with wide forbidden band, the quantum well is delimited laterally - in the plane of the layers - by a depopulated region (22) which forms a quantum pocket of smaller dimensions than the de Broglie wavelength. Application to fast electronics (200 GHz). <IMAGE>

title: Quantum-Annealing Computer Method for Selecting the Optimum Bids in a Combinatorial Auction
abstract: An improved method uses quantum processing devices to determine optimal sets of bids in combinatorial auctions. In one approach, a list of bids is received. Each bid specifies a price for a package of one or more items offered in the auction. The bids may be conflicting. An objective function based on the list of bids is formulated. The objective function has a form suitable for solution by a quantum processing device, which is used to optimize the objective function, thereby determining which bids are accepted.

title: QUANTUM ENCRYPTION COMMUNICATION SYSTEM AND TRANSMISSION APPARATUS
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To properly verify a quantum state received in a commit phase of a quantum bit string commitment system, even when the quantum state is immediately observed without holding it to a disclosure phase, in a system for performing encryption communication using quantum.

SOLUTION: A quantum encryption communication system is configured of a transmission apparatus 1 and a reception apparatus 2 connected via a quantum communication path 11 and a classical communication path 12. The carrier transmission section 14 of the transmission apparatus 1 transmits a quantum to the quantum communication path 11 and the carrier receiving section 17 of the reception apparatus 2 receives the quantum and observes the quantum state. A receiving apparatus control section 16 uses an observation result and data transmitted from the data transmission section 15 of the transmission apparatus 1 through the classical communication path 12 to the data reception section 18 of the reception apparatus 2 to perform arithmetic operation, and outputs the result of encryption communication derived from the arithmetic operation.
