title: Quantum reinforcement learning agent
abstract: Systems, computer-implemented methods, and computer program products that can facilitate applying a reinforcement learning policy to available actions are described. According to an embodiment, a system can comprise a memory that stores computer executable components and a processor that executes the computer executable components stored in the memory. The computer executable components can comprise a state encoder that maps, based on one or more encoding parameters, a state of an environment on to one or more qubits of a quantum device. The system can further comprise a variational component that combines a reinforcement learning policy with a sampling of the one or more qubits, resulting, based on one or more variational parameters, in a probability distribution of a plurality of available actions at the state of the environment.

title: Intruder detection using quantum key distribution
abstract: Intruder detection using quantum key distribution is disclosed. A request for a first key for use with a first application configured to execute on a computing device is received by a quantum computing system. The request includes information that identifies the application. In response to the request, a quantum key distribution (QKD) process to generate a key is initiated. It is determined that an intruder attempted to eavesdrop on the QKD process. A message is sent to the computing device that instructs the computing device to cause the first application to implement a reduced functionality mode of the first application.

title: Method for compressing color computer hologram through quantum neural network based on gradient optimization
abstract: The invention provides a method for compressing a color computer hologram through a quantum neural network based on gradient optimization, and belongs to the technical field of compression and transmission of computer holograms. According to the invention, a color computer hologram is manufactured by adopting a bandwidth-limited angular spectrum method for calculation and a double-phase encoding mode. A method for compressing a color computer hologram in an RGB color space through a gradient-optimized quantum neural network is provided, and corresponding network models are trained according to the characteristics of computer holograms with different wavelengths. The computer hologram decompressed by the method is reproduced by adopting a bandwidth-limited angular spectrum method, and is synthesized into a color reproduced image. According to the invention, the compression of the color computer hologram is accelerated, and higher decompressed color computer hologram and color reproduced image quality are obtained.

title: Two-party quantum private comparison method based on five-quantum bit entangled state
abstract: The invention discloses a two-party quantum private comparison method based on a five-quantum bit entangled state. The two-party quantum private comparison method is used for comparing whether secrets of two users are equal or not in size. The two-party quantum private comparison method has the advantages that the method needs help of a semi-loyal third party (Third Party, TP), the TP is allowed to mistakenly act according to the wish of the TP, but is not allowed to conspire with any one of the two users; one five-quantum bit entangled state can be used for achieving two-bit equality comparison in all comparison; unitary operation and the quantum entanglement swapping technology are not required in the method, it is avoided that expensive quantum devices related by unitary operation and the quantum entanglement swapping technology are consumed; Bell measurement and single-particle measurement are only adopted in the method, and the quantum measurement can be achieved with the existing quantum technology; safety performance according to outside attack and participant attack is guaranteed; secret information and the comparative result of the two users are not revealed to the TP.

title: QUANTUM COMPUTATION SYSTEM AND QUANTUM DEVICE MANUFACTURING METHOD
abstract: A quantum computation system (1) has a quantum device (21), and a control unit (10) that controls the quantum device. The quantum device has a first qubit (100), a second qubit (200), a magnetic flux qubit (300) for coupling that can couple with the first qubit and the second qubit, and a first magnetic flux application unit (340) that applies a magnetic flux to the magnetic flux qubit for coupling. The control unit causes the first magnetic flux application unit to apply a first magnetic flux, which is provided with a first time modulation, during a first period, and apply a second magnetic flux, which is provided with a second time modulation differing from the first time modulation, during a second time period differing from the first time period. This quantum computation system can be used, for example, in quantum computing.

title: Method for improving CO2 gas adsorption performance of single-layer hydrotalcite
abstract: The invention provides a method for improving the CO2 gas adsorption performance of single-layer hydrotalcite. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a plurality of single-layer hydrotalcite models with different phases and different metal doping sites by adopting a density functional theory in a first principle and using Material Studio 5.5 quantum simulation software; characterizing the CO2 adsorption capacity of the single-layer hydrotalcites doped with different metals by Dmol3 software package; screening to obtain a single-layer hydrotalcite structure with good CO2 adsorption capacity according to the characterization data; and successfully constructing the single-layer hydrotalcite structure by a density functional theory simulation method. The stability of the single-layer hydrotalcite structure can be rapidly predicted by changing doping metal atoms, the experimental synthesis period is shortened, the adsorption capacity of the single-layer hydrotalcite with different components to CO2 can be simulated through quantum chemistry software, and the single-layer hydrotalcite structure with high adsorption capacity to CO2 can be screened through the characterization data.

title: GaN dual field plate device with single field plate metal
abstract: A low leakage current transistor (2) is provided which includes a GaN-containing substrate (11-14) covered by a passivation surface layer (17) in which a T-gate electrode with sidewall extensions (20) is formed and coated with a multi-level passivation layer (30-32) which includes an intermediate etch stop layer (31) which is used to define a continuous multi-region field plate (33) having multiple distances between the bottom surface of the field plate 33 and the semiconductor substrate in the gate-drain region of the transistor.

title: MAGNETIC RACETRACK MEMORY DEVICE
abstract: A racetrack memory device facilitates the manipulation of a series of domain walls along the racetrack. The racetrack is designed so that the domain wall energy increases and decreases in a continuous fashion between adjacent pinning sites, so that a domain wall does not become stuck between them. The variation in the domain wall energy along the racetrack can be provided by continuous variations of the racetrack's width (while maintaining constant thickness) and/or cross-sectional area (in which the racetrack dimensions are varied in both directions perpendicular to the length of the racetrack). Alternatively, this variation in domain wall energy may be provided by varying the magnetic properties of the racetrack along the racetrack while otherwise keeping the shape and size of the racetrack unchanged. In addition, variations of the racetrack's composition and/or shape can be used.

title: Model training method and device for generating quantum state, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention provides a training method of a generative model, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of generative artificial intelligence and quantum computing. According to the specific implementation scheme, a sample measurement result is obtained according to quantum state sample data, the sample measurement result is added to a first training sample set, and the first training sample set is used for training a first generation model; obtaining parameter data according to the sample measurement result; adjusting the quantum neural network of the second generation model by using the parameter data to obtain an adjusted quantum neural network; using the adjusted quantum neural network to generate quantum state output data; and training a second generation model according to the quantum state sample data and the quantum state output data. The invention further provides a data generation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium.

title: Quantum key output control system and method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a quantum key output control system and a method thereof. The system comprises an application layer, a key management layer and a server layer, wherein the application layer comprises an application layer device of a sender and an application layer device of a receiver, the key management layer comprises a key management layer device of the sender and a key management layer device of the receiver, and the server layer comprises a server layer device. The method adopts the following steps that: the application layer device of the sender and the application layer deviceof the receiver access a quantum network, and perform a user key session through the corresponding key management layer device and the server layer device respectively; and after the user key sessionis successful, the server layer device sends key session information generated by the user key session to the key management layer device of the sender and the key management layer device of the receiver respectively to perform key output control, and the application layer device of the sender and the application layer device of the receiver receive the controlled quantum key respectively.

title: Method of forming a T-gate Lightly-Doped Drain semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor processing method for forming self-aligned T-gate Lightly-Doped Drain (LDD) device of recessed channel is presented. The method comprises the steps of covering a substrate with pad oxide, forming a lightly-doped layer by ion implantation, depositing a silicon nitride layer on the surface of the pad oxide, and etching the silicon nitride layer according to a predefined mask pattern to expose the silicon oxide layer and to form a gate region. A polysilicon spacer region is formed on the side-walls of the silicon nitride layer. Anisotropic etch is used to etch the polysilicon spacer region, and at the same time etch the exposed pad oxide and a portion of the substrate to form a T-shaped groove. An amorphous silicon layer is deposited in the T-shaped groove after forming a thin oxide layer, then the amorphous silicon deposited apart from the T-shaped groove region is removed. The silicon nitride layer is removed to form a T-gate. Ion implantation is used to form a heavily-doped source/drain, and finally metal contacts are formed on the polysilicon T-gate and the heavily-doped source/drain regions.

title: COMBINATION OPTIMIZATION SYSTEM AND COMBINATION OPTIMIZATION METHOD
abstract: An objective of the present invention is to provide a combination optimization system and combination optimization method which efficiently optimize a multiple valued optimization problem. Provided is a combination optimization system (10) comprising: an input unit (11) which receives an input of a multiple valued optimization problem; an evaluation function generation unit (12) which generates an evaluation function which expresses the multiple valued optimization problem in binary using a half-hot constraint; an Ising machine (13) which carries out an optimization using the evaluation function; and an optimization control unit (14) which controls a halving unit (15) formed from the evaluation function generation unit (12) and the Ising machine (13) so as to repeatedly generate and optimize the evaluation function to derive an optimal solution to the multiple valued optimization problem.

title: TWO PART HARD SHELL CAPSULE MADE OF POLY (1,4-ALPHA-D-GLUCAN)AND STARCH
abstract: The present invention relates to hard shell capsules consisting of two parts made from a poly (1,4- alpha -D-glucan)and starch based composition and the manufacturing thereof, preferentially by a dipping and pin moulding process.

title: QUANTUM DOT FABRICATION PROCESS USING STRAINED EPIQUANTUM DOT FABRICATION PROCESS USING STRAINED EPITAXIAL GROWTH TAXIAL GROWTH
abstract: A process for production of self-assembled quantum dots is described which does not entail any processing steps before or after growth of the quantum dots. The process uses in situ formation of three dimensional islands which occurs during epitaxy of material with a different lattice parameter than the substrate. Further deposition of the substrate material then produces single or multiple buried two dimensional layers of randomly distributed or selectively positioned and substantially uniform sized quantum dots. These layers are free of defects and interface states. The lateral dot diameters vary between 140 to 300 Angstroms by appropriate choice of deposition parameters.

title: High efficiency thermoelectric materials and devices
abstract: Growth of thermoelectric materials in the form of quantum well superlattices on three-dimensionally structured substrates provide the means to achieve high conversion efficiency of the thermoelectric module combined with inexpensiveness of fabrication and compatibility with large scale production. Thermoelectric devices utilizing thermoelectric materials in the form of quantum well semiconductor superlattices grown on three-dimensionally structured substrates provide improved thermoelectric characteristics that can be used for power generation, cooling and other applications.

title: DISCRIMINATION METHOD FOR QUBIT STATES
abstract: A method for discriminating a quantum state according to the present invention is a method for discriminating a quantum state to allow decision suspension according to an inconclusive degree q0. The method comprises a step of calculating a decision suspension probability P1(q) on a positive number q; a step of calculating a maximum true probability Poptcor(q) for the q; a step of calculating a maximum likelihood decision probability Roptcor(Q) based on the P1(q) and the Poptcor(q); and a step of selecting the q which allows the Roptcor(Q) to equal to or greater than a reference value and determining the q0. It is possible to maximize the maximum true probability Roptcor(Q) when decision suspension is allowed.

title: Network jump generation device and method based on quantum key distribution
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of quantum information processing, in particular to a network hopping generation device and method based on quantum key distribution, and the device comprises a quantum key processing part and a random pattern generation part. The quantum key processing completes key acquisition, distribution and storage of one-time pad, and a quantum key generated by the QKD is converted into a signal format required by a network hopping pattern; the random pattern generation completes the generation of network hopping patterns of different network element nodes, and generates the random hopping patterns as required by using a quantum key, thereby realizing relatively secure network frequency hopping. According to the network hopping generation method based on the quantum key distribution technology provided by the invention, hopping pattern generation of quantum key distribution can be realized, a dynamic key generation service based on a quantum key adaptive hopping pattern is provided for a user, and fusion of a quantum secret communication technology and network application is promoted; the research, development and application of the quantum key technology are effectively verified, and the actual security of an information network is improved.

title: Quantum bit processing method, computer readable storage medium and computer equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a quantum bit processing method, a computer readable storage medium and computer equipment. The method relates to the technical field of quantum, and comprises the following steps: controlling a quantum bit to be biased at a predetermined frequency; the relation between the frequency of an adjustable resonant cavity and the magnetic flux offset applied to the adjustable resonant cavity is obtained, and the adjustable resonant cavity is a resonant cavity coupled with quantum bits; based on the relationship, determining a target magnetic flux offset corresponding to energy level splitting of the adjustable resonant cavity, the energy level splitting representing that resonance is generated between the adjustable resonant cavity and the quantum bit; the target magnetic flux bias is controlled to be applied to the adjustable resonant cavity for a preset time period, and the quantum bits are initialized. According to the invention, the technical problem that the initialization efficiency is low when the quantum bit is initialized in the prior art is solved.

title: OPERATION PROGRAM, OPERATION METHOD, AND INFORMATION PROCESSING APPARATUS
abstract: An operation program causes a computer to execute a process of, in a case where an operation processing is repeatedly executed which includes creating an Ising model based on a learning data group, searching for a first set number of first recommended points for the Ising model, searching for a second set number of second recommended points for the learning data group by a genetic algorithm, and adding the first recommended points and first evaluation values of the first recommended points and the second recommended points and second evaluation values of the second recommended points to the learning data group as learning data, expressing each piece of learning data of the learning data group as an objective variable obtained by a linear weighted sum of a plurality of objective functions, and changing a weight of the linear weighted sum every time the operation processing is executed.

title: SELF-ALIGNED T-GATE CARBON NANOTUBE FIELD EFFECT TRANSISTOR DEVICES AND METHOD FOR FORMING THE SAME
abstract: A method is provided for forming a self-aligned carbon nanotube (CNT) field effect transistor (FET). According to one feature, a self-aligned source-gate-drain (S-G-D) structure is formed that allows for the shrinking of the gate length to arbitrarily small values, thereby enabling ultra-high performance CNT FETs. In accordance with another feature, an improved design of the gate to possess a 'T'-shape, referred to as the 'T-Gate,' thereby enabling a reduction in gate resistance and further providing an increased power gain. The self-aligned T-gate CNT FET is formed using simple fabrication steps to ensure a low cost, high yield process.

title: Preparation method of topological quantum single crystal Cu3TeO6
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a topological quantum single crystal Cu3TeO6. In the preparation method, the topological quantum single crystal Cu3TeO6 is prepared by adopting a moltensalt method, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: growing a mixture containing raw materials and a fluxing agent to obtain the topological quantum single crystal Cu3TeO6; whereinthe raw materials comprise a Cu source and a Te source; and the fluxing agent is PbCl2. The preparation method provided by the invention can be used for growing large single crystals, and is perfectin crystal form and easy to separate.

title: Quantum weight adder construction method and device, medium and electronic device
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method and device of a quantum weight adder, a medium and an electronic device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a variable bit and the weight of the variable bit, and obtaining a summation bit and a carry bit based on the weight; and enabling a controlled NOT gate to act on the variable bit, the summation bit and the carry bit based on the weight to obtain a quantum weight adder, thereby realizing the construction of the quantum weight adder, constructing a quantum algorithm through the quantum weight adder, and accelerating the solving of the problem of a complex system.

title: Calculating device
abstract: According to one embodiment, a calculating device includes a nonlinear oscillator. The nonlinear oscillator includes a circuit part including a first Josephson junction and a second Josephson junction, and a conductive member including a first terminal. An electrical signal is input to the first terminal. The electrical signal includes a first signal in a first operation. The first signal includes a first frequency component having a first frequency, and a second frequency component having a second frequency. The first frequency is 2 times an oscillation frequency of the nonlinear oscillator. An absolute value of a difference between the first frequency and the second frequency is not more than 0.3 times the first frequency.

title: Systems and methods for quantum key generation
abstract: A quantum key generation system including two photon detector units, two photon entanglement chains extending between the two photon detector units, and a plurality of multicore fiber links each including at least two non-uniform cores structurally configured to provide non-uniform photon propagation delay. Each photon entanglement chain includes at least one quantum repeater structurally configured to entangle a pair of photons and first and second terminating quantum memories optically coupled the quantum repeater using the multicore fiber links such that photons received by the first and the second terminating quantum memories are entangled with photons entangled by the quantum repeater. The first and second terminating quantum memories of each of the two photon entanglement chains form first and second cross-chain quantum repeaters, and the first and the second photon detector units are structurally configured to receive the measurable entangled particles generated by the first and second cross-chain quantum repeaters, respectively.

title: COATED COMPOSITES OF MAGNETIC MATERIAL AND QUANTUM DOTS
abstract: Composites and methods associated with the same are provided. The composite structures (10) are formed of quantum dots (12) and magnetic nanoparticles (14). The structures may be coated, for example, with a non-organic shell such as silica. In some cases, the shell may be functionalized or derivatized to include compounds, atoms, or materials that can alter or improve properties such as water solubility, water stability, photo-stability and biocompatibility. A reverse microemulsion process can be used to form the coated composites. The composition and other characteristics of the composites may be controlled to provide desired magnetic and optical properties. The structures may be used in a variety of applications including biological labeling, magnetic resonance imagine (MRI) and drug targeting, amongst others.

title: QUANTUM DOT DEVICES WITH TOP GATES
abstract: Disclosed herein are quantum dot devices, as well as related computing devices and methods. For example, in some embodiments, a quantum dot device may include: a quantum well stack; a plurality of gates disposed on the quantum well stack; and a top gate at least partially disposed on the plurality of gates such that the plurality of gates are at least partially disposed between the top gate and the quantum well stack.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR BALLISTIC SINGLE FLUX QUANTUM LOGIC
abstract: In one embodiment, the disclosure relates to a single flux quantum (SFQ) signal transmission line powered by an AC power source. The AC power source supplies power to a transformer having a primary winding and a secondary winding. The primary winding receives the AC signal and the secondary winding communicates the signal to the SFQ transmission line. The transmission line can optionally include an input filter circuit (125) for receiving the incoming SFQ pulse. The filter circuit can have a resistor (123) and an inductor (122) connected in parallel. A first Josephson junction (110) can be connected to the filter circuit and to the secondary winding. The Josephson junction triggers in response to the incoming SFQ pulse and regenerates a pulse signal in response to a power discharge from the secondary winding.

title: CLUSTER-STATE QUANTUM COMPUTING METHODS AND SYSTEMS
abstract: A method for cluster-state quantum computing method includes transforming a Gaussian graph state into a non-Gaussian percolated graph state by probabilistically subtracting one photon from each of a plurality of modes forming the Gaussian graph state. The method also includes determining cat-basis qubits of the non-Gaussian percolated graph state for which one photon was successfully subtracted from a corresponding one of the modes, and identifying in the non-Gaussian percolated graph state a renormalized graph of logical qubits connected by percolation highways. The logical qubits and percolation highways are formed from the cat-basis qubits. The renormalized graph and the non-Gaussian percolated graph state are outputted to a one-way quantum computer to implementing a quantum computing algorithm.

title: Application control method based on quantum network, security execution module and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of quantum communication, and discloses an application management and control method based on a quantum network, a security execution module and a storage medium. The application control method based on the quantum network is applied to a first security execution module on a fusion security management platform side, and comprises the following steps: applying for a first quantum key to the quantum network, the first quantum key being used for generating a first session key; a first management and control instruction encrypted based on the first session key is sent to a second security execution module through the quantum network, and the first management and control instruction is used for indicating to stop using a first working key used by an application. And the second security execution module decrypts the received encrypted first management and control instruction according to the first session key to obtain the first management and control instruction, and stops using the first working key to realize management and control of the application.

title: Superconducting circuit with superconductive layer covered step area and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a superconducting circuit with a superconductive layer covered step area and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises following steps: 1) providing a substrate and forming a three-layer film structure on the substrate, wherein the three-layer film structure is formed by a first superconducting material layer, a first insulating material layer, and a second superconducting material layer which are successively arranged; 2) etching the second superconducting material layer, the first insulating material layer and the first superconducting material layer to form a bottom electrode and a Josephson junction; 3) forming a second insulating material layer on the structure surface obtained in step 2); 4) depositing bypass resistance material layer, and etching the bypass resistance material layer to form a bypass resistance; 5) depositing a third superconducting material layer, and etching the third superconducting material layer to form a wiring layer and a superconducting coating layer. By use of the method, the bypass resistance on the bottom electrode surface and the bypass resistance on the second insulating material layer surface are guaranteed to be conducted, and therefore, the open circuit fault is avoided, the stability of bypass resistance connectivity is guaranteed, and the work performance of superconducting circuit structure is increased.

title: Patterned component, structure and columnar array and manufacturing method and application of patterned component and structure and columnar array
abstract: The invention discloses a graphical component, a graphical structure, a columnar array and a manufacturing method and application of the graphical component and the columnar array, and belongs to the field of quantum chip manufacturing. The manufacturing method comprises the steps that patterning operation is carried out on a composite film layer which is formed on the surface of a substrate and comprises a photoresist layer and a stripping layer, so that an exposed patterned structure is obtained, and then the composite film layer is removed. According to the manufacturing method, the stripping layer is configured in a certain area of the photoresist, so that unwanted materials can be stripped conveniently after patterning operation, and a patterned structure with high surface quality can be obtained quickly.

title: Water-soluble Hg<2+> fluorescent probe and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of biological detection and specifically relates to a water-soluble Hg<2+> fluorescent probe and a preparation method thereof. A structural formula of the water-soluble Hg<2+> fluorescent probe is as shown in a figure in the specification. The water-soluble Hg<2+> fluorescent probe contains a rhodamine fluorophore with high sensitivity, good light stability, highfluorescent quantum yield and long wavelength and glucose with good water solubility. A certain amount of rhodamine lactam and the glucose are subjected to a condensation reaction under certain conditions to obtain the water-soluble fluorescent probe. A synthetic process has simple and easily-available raw materials, mild reaction conditions and simple operation, and the obtained water-soluble Hg<2+> fluorescent probe can quickly detect substances in biological cells in an aquatic environment.

title: Thermal active delay fluorescent (TADF) molecular material, synthesis method thereof, and electroluminescence device
abstract: The invention provides a thermal active delay fluorescent (TADF) molecular material, a synthesis method thereof, and an electroluminescence device. A series of nitrogenous-carbonyl type TADF moleculesis synthesized, and the nitrogenous-carbonyl type TADF molecules have an intramolecular multiple resonance effect so that a luminescence spectrum can be narrowed well; and the nitrogenous-carbonyl type TADF molecules are provided with super-large planes, large rigidity can be shown, thus the molecules have the high intersystem crossing speed constant and inverse intersystem crossing speed constant, radiative transition speed lowering caused by the energy gap law can be effectively inhibited, thus the high photoluminescence quantum yield (PLQY) is obtained, meanwhile the stability of the TADFmaterial is improved, and the life of the device can be prolonged.

title: QUANTUM BIT ELEMENT STRUCTURE IN QUANTUM COMPUTER AND QUANTUM CORRELATION GATE ELEMENT STRUCTURE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a quantum bit element structure and a quantum correlation gate element structure in a quantum computer, which can realize quantum bit and quantum correlation gate. SOLUTION: A quantum dot 12 having a quantum level 16 and a quantum dot 14, having a quantum level 18 which is different from the quantum level 16, are provided. The quantum dot 12 and quantum dot 4 are provided close to each other so that electrons are freely movable between the quantum dot 12 and quantum dot 14 through tunnel effect, and moreover only one electron is made to exist there.

title: MOLECULAR ELECTRO-OPTICAL SWITCHING OR MEMORY DEVICE, AND METHOD OF MAKING THE SAME
abstract: Observable changes in electrical and optical characteristics of individual molecules adsorbed on a conductor or semi-conductor caused by electrical and/or optical excitation or de-excitation of electrons within such molecules can be used as signals which in turn can be used to carry information and such observable information carrying changes or signals can be switched, amplified, and modulated by varying optical as well as electrical inputs to such molecules. Molecular structural design alters functional behavior of the molecular/quantum devices. In an example, monomeric metallated phthalocyanine behaves as a fast ( < 10-12second), energy efficient ( 3OkT/bit of information), fully reversible quantum switch with multiple outputs. However, if monomeric phthalocyanines are organized in structural combinations such as one dimensional wire-like ring-stacked, or two dimensional sheet-like ring-fused phthalocyanines, their electro-optical properties are significantly altered. As a consequence, their functionality behaves with properties that can replace a multiplicity of CMOS and similar classic semiconductor devices.

title: Recessed poly extension T-gate
abstract: A method is provided for making a silicided gate in a semiconductor device. In accordance with the method, a gate (213) is provided which comprises a first portion (214) and a second portion (213). The first portion of the gate has a width w1 and the second portion of the gate has a width w2 as taken along a plane perpendicular to the length of the gate, wherein w2>w1. A layer is silicide (231) is then formed on the second portion.

title: HIGH TEMPERATURE DRIVING BLUE LIGHT EMITTING DIODE WITH EXCELLENT LIGHTNESS
abstract: Disclosed is a high temperature driving blue light emitting diode with excellent brightness. A high temperature driving blue light emitting diode according to the present invention includes an n-type nitride semiconductor layer made of nitride doped with an n-type impurity; a p-type nitride semiconductor layer made of nitride doped with an p-type impurity; an active layer formed between the n-type nitride semiconductor layer and the p-type nitride semiconductor layer. The active layer is formed by alternately stacking quantum wall layers and quantum well layers. At least one among the quantum wall layers includes a heterogeneous quantum wall layer which has different composition from the quantum wall layer.

title: Beryllium bronze alloy corrosion rate prediction method based on quantum support vector machine
abstract: The invention provides a beryllium bronze alloy corrosion rate prediction method based on a quantum support vector machine, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the data collection processing and main cause analysis of a plurality of factors having important influences in a beryllium bronze alloy corrosion process based on a machine learning algorithm; a quantum least square support vector machine combined with a quantum algorithm is used for building a beryllium bronze alloy corrosion prediction model in the salt spray environment, and the model is used for efficiently and accurately predicting the beryllium bronze alloy corrosion rate.

title: PROGRAMMABLE JOSEPHSON VOLTAGE STANDARD USING MICROWAVES OF MULTIPLE FREQUENCY
abstract: A programmable Josephson voltage standard system using multi-frequency microwave is provided to quickly obtain voltage change by dividing a junction into plural groups and sets and applying multiple microwave. A programmable Josephson voltage standard system using multi-frequency microwave is composed of a first element group(10a) having a plurality of Josephson junctions(2) connected in series and receiving first frequency(f1); a second element group(20a) having a plurality of Josephson junctions connected in series and receiving second frequency(f2) different from the first frequency; and a current bias unit for selectively applying plus or minus current to the Josephson junctions of each element group or cutting off the current supply according to an input order. The first and second element groups are connected in series.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MATCHING USERS SERENDIPITOUSLY BASED ON A QUANTUM PROCESSING UNIT
abstract: A system and method for matching people serendipitously in time, with location and within situational context based on computations performed by a quantum processing unit is disclosed. Opportunities for communicating or meeting with candidate matches in a specified context over a network are provided to a user by way of a matching service module. A quantum processor generates distribution states for each user in relation to its candidate matches with potential opportunities to communicate and meet, based on monitored changes associated with the user and the plurality of data collected such as answers the user may give to survey questions, ratings provided by the user, environmental data imported over a network, data by third party applications and data provided by other users over a network. The distribution states, being computed by at least one quantum algorithm embodied on at least one quantum processing unit, and provided for each user represent a suggestion as a possible opportunity to meet with matched candidate serendipitously as determined by the system. The system therefore provides the specified opportunities to meet and engage in time, location and within situational context based on quantum computations and continuously monitors and collects data by computing new opportunities arising from various changes occurring and depending on a given opportunity spaces.

title: Quantum true random number generation method based on weak coherent pulse sequence
abstract: The invention discloses a quantum true random number generation method and system based on a weak coherence pulse sequence, and a storage medium. A single-photon sequence is generated by the single-photon light source or the attenuation and weak coherence pulse sequence, path selection and light path construction are realized by the cascade beam splitter, output port detection is achieved through a multi-channel single-photon detector or a time division multiplexing system and a single-channel single-photon detector, laser pulses with fixed repetition frequency are attenuated through an optical attenuator, and the average photon number of single pulses is reduced to obtain empty pulses and a weak coherent pulse sequence with the characteristics close to those of single photons. The true random number generated by the true random number generator conforms to the basic principle of quantum mechanics, has the advantages of high generation rate, good stability, simple structure, easiness in integration and the like, can be used as a brand new scheme of the true random number generator, and provides important support for applications such as secure communication, machine learning, random algorithms and the like.

title: SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICE WITH T-GATE OF DOUBLE DECK STRUCTURE AND METHOD OF FABRICATING THE SAME
abstract: Disclosed is a method for manufacturing a semiconductor element having a dual T-gate structure. The method of the present invention comprises the steps of: forming a gate pattern on a predetermined area of a semiconductor substrate; depositing an insulating film on a side wall of the gate pattern; performing dry etching on the insulating film formed on the side wall, and then performing wet etching on the insulating film subjected to the dry etching; additionally performing dry etching and wet etching in order to form a gate; forming an interlayer insulating film by using n^(++)-GaN subjected to the dry etching and the wet etching; performing gate patterning on the formed interlayer insulating film to etch the n^(++)-GaN layer; and forming a source, a drain and the gate. According to the method for manufacturing a semiconductor element having a dual T-gate structure, an ultrafine dual T-gate can be realized, which is difficult to be realized by means of conventional E-beam lithography. Accordingly, gate resistance of the dual T-gate structure will ultimately decrease, thereby bringing characteristics of high oscillation frequency and low noise.

title: Quantum key service method separated from quantum network and system thereof
abstract: The invention provides a quantum key service method separated from a quantum network, and the method comprises the steps: a first server obtains a certain number of exclusive-or associated slices as a slice set, randomly selects and calculates the exclusive-or values of m associated exclusive-or values in m slices in each service, and transmits the exclusive-or values to a second server; and the second server calculates the exclusive-or values of the corresponding m quantum key groups and performs Hash operation to obtain a key group, then encrypts the key group by using the random number group of the client and sends the key group to the client, and the client decrypts the key group to obtain the key group. The method can solve the problem of large-scale application of quantum key distribution, and has a good application prospect in the field of quantum security services.

title: Use of photoluminescent nanoparticles for photodynamic therapy
abstract: Disclosed are compositions and methods that can be used to effect a photodynamic therapy (PDT) such as cancer treatment or gene transcription. Compositions include light-emitting nanoparticles that absorb light of one wavelength emitted by a light source and emit light of another wavelength that activates a PDT drug. Light-emitting nanoparticles include quantum dots, nanocrystals, and quantum rods as well as mixtures of these nanoparticles. The nanoparticles may be delivered to a patient in a liquid carrier or as part of a solid carrier such as a biocompatible polymeric film, a polymeric sheath, or other carrier suitable for introduction at the site to be treated. In one embodiment of the invention, light-emitting nanoparticles are localized at the treatment site by either joining them to the PDT drug covalently or non-covalently through linkage groups such as biotin/avidin, or the nanoparticles are localized at the treatment site by attaching the nanoparticles to a linkage group that has affinity for e.g. cells or proteins produced at the site to the treated. A sufficient number of light-emitting nanoparticles are delivered to the treatment site to activate the PDT drug and effect treatment.

title: Method for manufacturing a nanowire structure with pyramidal quantum dot
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for producing a nanowire structure comprising a pyramidal quantum dot. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the production method comprises the following steps: (a) preparing a substrate; (b) growing a first conductive semiconductor on the substrate; and (c) consecutively supplying a group V precursor onto the first conductive semiconductor grown in a vertical nanowire form, while supplying a group III precursor in a pulse method, so as to form a quantum dot. According to the other aspect of the present invention, as the quantum dot has a pyramidal conformation, it is possible to increase light-emitting and/or light-receiving efficiency in terms of a light-emitting diode and/or a solar cell.

title: CLOUD STORAGE METHOD AND SYSTEM
abstract: Disclosed are a cloud storage method and system. The method comprises: generating, by a QKD system of a terminal side and the QKD system of at least one cloud server side, and by a quantum network, at least one quantum encryption key; processing, by a cloud storage client, at least one quantum encryption key via a preset encryption algorithm to generate a combined encryption key. The above method combines a quantum encryption key allocation technique and a cloud storage technique. The present invention utilizes the natural advantages of cloud storage distribution and that quantum encryption key allocation readily generates a massive random number encryption key and that the encryption key is hard to eavesdrop, such that a malicious attacker cannot acquire the quantum encryption key or crack the combined encryption key, thus significantly ensuring cloud storage data safety.

title: Quantum state remote preparation model, method and device based on quantum network coding
abstract: The invention discloses a quantum state remote preparation model, method and device based on quantum network coding. In the steps (1)-(4), the particles on each network node are entangled into the whole quantum system through the corresponding quantum coding operation. A quantum state after each entanglement is specifically given; in steps (5)-(9), all unnecessary particles are de-entangled from the entire quantum system by performing corresponding quantum measurements, referred to as decoding operations, while retaining certain particles on the target node. The quantum state generated after each deentanglement is also specifically displayed. Therefore, after all the encoding and decoding steps, the final quantum state formed at the target node is completely the same as the initial source state at the source node.

title: Testing structure, quantum chip and manufacturing and testing method of quantum chip
abstract: The invention discloses a testing structure, a quantum chip and a manufacturing and testing method of the quantum chip, and belongs to the field of quantum chip packaging. The test structure comprises a first wire, a second wire, a plurality of conductive columns and a plurality of first measurement lines. Wherein the first wire and the second wire are located on different planes and are connected through a plurality of conductive columns which are arranged at intervals to form a tested circuit. The first measuring lines are independently connected with the first wires, so that two conductive columns are arranged between any two adjacent first measuring lines. Therefore, the connectivity of any group of conductive columns and the first wires and the second wires between the conductive columns can be measured by using the first measuring lines in the test structure.

title: Evanescent-wave coupled microcavity laser
abstract: Disclosed is an evanescent-wave-coupled microcavity laser in which a gain medium (120) is positioned outside a circularly symmetric microcavity (110) having a size of a few tens of microns to a few hundreds of microns to generate a laser oscillation using a gain medium existing in the evanescent-field of a resonance mode. Particularly, a gain medium containing a semiconductor, atoms, molecules, or quantum dots is placed outside the microcavity where the evanescent-wave of the microcavity mode exists, to be excited by an electric or an optical pumping. Fluorescence irradiated from the excited gain medium is coupled with the evanescent-wave of the resonator mode to obtain a gain, so that amplification of light is triggered. The amplified light circulates inside the microcavity through total internal reflection to induce a stimulated emission of radiation from the excited gain medium in the field of evanescent-wave so that a stable laser oscillation is established. Particularly, the present invention includes the evanescent-wave-coupled microcavity lasers using the microspheres of extremely low energy loss, microdisks or microcylinders capable of being large-scale integrated. <IMAGE>

title: Quantum Computing Circuit Providing Subset Summing Based Upon a Reward Matrix and Related Methods
abstract: A quantum computing circuit may include a plurality of column subset qubit registers and a plurality of row subset qubit registers, a reward matrix register configured to receive a reward matrix, and an adder coupled to the column subset qubit registers, the row subset qubit registers, and the reward matrix register. The adder may be configured to perform subset summing to generate reward matrix sums from column and row subset qubits and the reward matrix. The quantum computing circuit may further include a plurality of row action qubit registers, and a comparator coupled to the adder and the row action qubit registers and configured to generate an output based thereon.

title: SOLID-STATE IMAGING APPARATUS
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a back irradiation type solid-state imaging apparatus that can be improved in quantum efficiency by suppressing the occurrence of a dark current by suppressing the occurrence of crystal defects caused by metallic contamination during a process.

SOLUTION: The apparatus has a wiring layer 36 formed on a first surface of a p-type epitaxial layer 10, an n-type region 12 which is formed on the p-type epitaxial layer 10, and stores electric charges generated by photoelectric conversion, and a p+-type impurity layer 11 which is formed on a second surface side of the p-type epitaxial layer 10 rather than the n-type region 12, and has an impurity concentration higher than that of the p-type epitaxial layer 10. The device receives light from the second surface side of the p-type epitaxial layer 10. An impurity concentration of the p+-type impurity layer 11 has a gradient with a higher concentration toward the second surface side, and becomes the maximum concentration at a position on the second surface.
