title: Preparation method, device and equipment of quantum state and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and device of a quantum state, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the field of quantum. The method comprises the following steps: determining an initial quantum state of n quantum bits, wherein n is a positive integer; based on the n quantum bits and the Hamming weight k, constructing an initial first quantum state unitary transformation circuit through recursive decomposition; performing circuit depth compression on the weight allocation transformation operator based on idle quantum bits in the initial first quantum state unitary transformation circuit to obtain a first quantum state unitary transformation circuit; and acting the first quantum state unitary transformation circuit on the initial quantum state to obtain a first quantum state circuit. Idle quantum bits in an initial first quantum state unitary transformation circuit are used as auxiliary quantum bits, the operation parallelism of a quantum state preparation operator is improved through the auxiliary quantum bits, and circuit depth compression is performed on a weight distribution transformation circuit, so that the circuit depth of the first quantum state unitary transformation circuit is compressed; on this basis, the depth of the first quantum state circuit is compressed.

title: Silicon dioxide modified bismuth halide perovskite quantum dot photoluminescence material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a silicon dioxide modified bismuth halide perovskite quantum dot photoluminescence material and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a bismuth halide perovskite quantum dot colloidal solution by adopting an anti-solvent method, then introducing a silicon source into the perovskite quantum dot solution, adjusting the pH value of the system by adopting an alkaline solution in a mixed system of ethanol and dimethyl sulfoxide, stirring at a certain temperature, and centrifugally collecting precipitates afterthe reaction is finished, so as to obtain the silicon dioxide modified bismuth halide perovskite quantum dot photoluminescence material. The preparation method has the advantages that the prepared silicon dioxide coated bismuth halogen perovskite quantum dot is excellent in photoluminescence performance and good in stability, and still has fluorescence performance when exposed to water and air environment conditions, meanwhile, the preparation process is simple, and has a good application prospect in the field of photoluminescence.

title: Photoelectric co-packaging-based quantum noise source module and quantum noise source generation method
abstract: The invention discloses a photoelectric co-packaging-based quantum noise source module and a quantum noise source generation method. The quantum noise source module comprises a super-radiation light-emitting unit, a photoelectric detection unit and a trans-impedance amplifier unit, the super-radiation light-emitting unit is attached to the upper surface of a first substrate which is vertically placed, the photoelectric detection unit is attached to the upper surface of a second substrate which is horizontally placed, a light-emitting surface of the super-radiation light-emitting unit and a photosensitive surface of the photoelectric detection unit are arranged oppositely, a light path transmission free space is formed between the super-radiation light-emitting unit and the photoelectric detection unit, the super-radiation light-emitting unit spontaneously generates wide-spectrum radiation light beams, the wide-spectrum radiation light beams are optically coupled with the photoelectric detection unit through the light path free space, and the input end of the photoelectric detection unit detects and collects incident light signals. The trans-impedance amplifier unit is horizontally attached to the second substrate, the input end of the trans-impedance amplifier unit is connected with the output end of the photoelectric detection unit, the CPO photoelectric co-packaging technology is utilized, photoelectric chips are jointly packaged in the shell, and localization, miniaturization and stabilization of the quantum random number generator are achieved.

title: QUANTUM ALGORITHM AND DESIGN FOR A QUANTUM CIRCUIT ARCHITECTURE TO SIMULATE INTERACTING FERMIONS
abstract: Computer-implemented methods and systems define hardware constraints for quantum processors such that the time required to estimate the energy expectation value of a given fermionic Hamiltonian using the method of Bayesian Optimized Operator Expectation Algorithm (BOOEA) is minimized.

title: OPTICAL FIBRE WITH QUANTUM DOTS
abstract: An optical fibre comprises a tubular glass cladding (1) with a central openi ng (2), filled with a colloidal solution of quantum dots (4) in a support mediu m (3). The quantum dots may be caused to produce luminescence in response to input optical radiation, for example to produce optical amplification or las er radiation. A waveguide with an active medium comprising colloidal quantum do ts is claimed.

title: SYSTEM FOR DETECTING, LOCALIZING, AND TARGETING INTERNAL SITES IN VIVO USING OPTICAL CONTRAST AGENTS
abstract: A system for detecting, localizing and targeting a medical instrument toward a target tissue within the body using an optical contrast agent in which a light source (102) is optically coupled to the tissue to be diagnosed (135), a light detector (174) is optically coupled to the tissue to detect a portion of the light which passes through the tissue, and either one or both of the light source and light detector are coupled to a medical instrument (130) used in a medical procedure. A contrast locator engine (184) receives a signal from the detector and provides a target tissue output signal (195) based upon the localization and distribution of the contrast agent, allowing the target tissue to be detected, located, or imaged, and for the medical instrument to positioned or targeted relative to the target tissue, and for allowing the accuracy of placement or the progress of a procedure to be assessed in real time. A method for the system is also described.

title: BUSES FOR MODULAR QUBIT DEVICES
abstract: One or more systems, devices and/or methods of use herein relate to modular quantum devices. According to an embodiment, a device can comprise a first module comprising a first qubit coupled to a first transmission line resonator, and a second module comprising a second qubit coupled to a second transmission line resonator, wherein the first module is embodied on a first chip and wherein the second module is embodied on a second chip.

title: COMPUTATION IN MEMORY FOR ANNEAL PROCESSING USING BITWISE CAPACITIVE COUPLING
abstract: An annealing processor utilizes capacitive spin update circuits to generate values for determining if spin states should be updated. Each capacitive spin update circuit induces a voltage on a main capacitor via capacitive coupling with a plurality of capacitors of corresponding bit cells. Each bit cell receives a spin value and a spin coupling value. The induced charge is based, in part, on the spin values and spin coupling values.

title: AUTOMATIC FLOW CONTROL VALVE CONTROL DEVICE
abstract: A device for controlling a flow control valve (18) in the lid (10) of a pressure cooking apparatus. The device comprises a lid handle (12) in which a locking member (25) is radially slidable between two abutment positions to enable free movement of the valve (18) when in a first abutment position, and hold the valve (18) in a flow release position when in a second abutment position. The locking member (25) is resiliently slidable from a return position corresponding to its first aubutment position, and combined with a system (40) for automatically locking and releasing the slidable locking member, which system locks said locking member (25) in a position substantially corresponding to the second abutment position, and automatically releases it when the lid (12) is placed on the pan (1) of the cooking apparatus. The device may be used as a valve control device.

title: SUPERCONDUCTING OUTPUT AMPLIFIERS WITH INTERSTAGE FILTERS
abstract: Superconducting output amplifiers with interstage filters and related methods are described. An example superconducting output amplifier includes a first superconducting output amplifier stage and a second superconducting output amplifier stage. The superconducting output amplifier may further include a first terminal for receiving a first single flux quantum (SFQ) pulse train and coupling the SFQ pulse train to each of the first superconducting output amplifier stage and the second superconducting output amplifier stage. The superconducting output amplifier may further include an interstage filter comprising a damped Josephson junction (JJ) coupled between the first superconducting output amplifier stage and the second superconducting output amplifier stage, where the interstage filter is arranged to reduce distortion in an output voltage waveform generated by the superconducting output amplifier in response to at least the first SFQ pulse train.

title: STRESS CONTROL OF SEMICONDUCTOR MICROSTRUCTURES FOR THIN FILM GROWTH
abstract: A suspended semiconductor film is anchored to a substrate at at least two opposed anchor positions, and film segments are deposited on the semiconductor film adjacent to one or more of the anchor positions to apply either tensile or compressive stress to the semiconductor film between the film segments. A crystalline silicon film may be anchored to the substrate and have tensile stress applied thereto to reduce the lattice mismatch between the silicon and a silicon-germanium layer deposited onto the silicon film. By controlling the level of stress in the silicon film, the size, density and distribution of quantum dots formed in a high germanium content silicon-germanium film deposited on the silicon film can be controlled.

title: Process for automatic recognition of volume shapes
abstract: The process consists in decomposing (1....4) the shape to be recognised over an orthonormal basis of the vector space of three-dimensional shapes, formed by the eigenvectors common to the operators L<2> and Lz known from quantum mechanics as designating the square of the orbital angular momentum and the orbital angular momentum about the z axis of particles, in calculating (5) contravariant tensors of order 1 from the result of the decomposition, in calculating (6, 7) the geometrical invariants by tensor contraction so as to feed a shape classifier (8) with these invariants. Applications: industrial and medical imaging. <IMAGE>

title: GaN-based light-emitting diode epitaxial wafer and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a GaN-based light-emitting diode epitaxial wafer and a manufacturing method of the GaN-based light-emitting diode epitaxial wafer, and belongs to the technical field of semiconductors. The GaN-based light-emitting diode epitaxial wafer comprises a substrate, a buffering layer, an undoped GaN layer, an n-type layer, a multiple-quantum-well layer and a p-type layer, wherein the multiple-quantum-well layer is of a multi-cycle structure, each cycle of the multiple-quantum-well layer comprises an InGaN quantum-well layer and a quantum barrier layer which grows on the InGaN quantum-well layer, each quantum barrier layer comprises a first InGaN layer, an AlGaN layer and a second InGaN layer, and each AlGaN layer and each second InGaN layer grow on each first InGaN layer in sequence. According to the scheme, the first InGaN layer and the second InGaN layer of each quantum barrier layer make contact with each InGaN quantum-well layer, the InGaN quantum-well layers, the first InGaN layers and the second InGaN layers are made of the same materials, the degree of lattice mismatch is low, produced stress is low, the effect of a piezoelectric polarization electric field is poor, the degree of band bending of the InGaN quantum-well layers and the quantum barrier layers becomes lower, the capacity of restraining charge carriers is improved, and when high current is injected, serious leakage current cannot be formed.

title: STRAINED QUANTUM DOT DEVICES
abstract: Disclosed herein are quantum dot devices, as well as related computing devices and methods. For example, in some embodiments, a quantum dot device may include: a quantum well stack including a barrier layer and a quantum well layer; gates disposed on the quantum well stack such that the barrier layer is disposed between the gates and the quantum well layer; and strain material regions that extend through the barrier layer and into the quantum well layer. In some embodiments, a quantum dot device may include: a quantum well stack including a quantum well layer; first gates disposed on the quantum well stack in an array, wherein each first gate has a spacer disposed on either side of the first gate; one or more second gates disposed between adjacent ones of the first gates; and lattice mismatch regions disposed under the spacers, extending into the quantum well layer.

title: SUSPENDED JOSEPHSON JUNCTIONS
abstract: Described herein are structures that include Josephson Junctions to be used in superconducting qubits of quantum circuits disposed on a substrate. In one aspect of the present disclosure, at least a part of a Josephson Junction of a superconducting qubit is suspended over a substrate, forming a gap between at least the portion of the Josephson Junction and the substrate. Moving at least a portion of the Josephson Junction further away from the substrate by suspending at least a part of the Junction over the substrate allows reducing spurious two-level systems present in the vicinity of the Junction, which, in turn, improves on the qubit decoherence problem. Methods for fabricating such structures are disclosed as well.

title: Device, system and method for quantum computing cloud platform evaluation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of quantum cloud platform evaluation, and discloses a device for quantum computing cloud platform evaluation, which comprises a test script configuration module for receiving evaluation content and obtaining a test script according to the evaluation content, importing the test script into the to-be-measured sub-computing cloud platform and triggering the to-be-measured sub-computing cloud platform to run the test script to obtain a test result; the evaluation determination configuration module receives a first user instruction, determines evaluation content corresponding to the first user instruction, sends the evaluation content to the test script configuration module and triggers the test script configuration module to obtain a test script; the evaluation content is sent to the data processing module, the data processing module is triggered to evaluate the test result according to the evaluation content, and evaluation of the quantum computing cloud platform is achieved. The invention also discloses a system and a method for quantum computing cloud platform evaluation.

title: Biomolecular synthesis of quantum dot composites
abstract: A biomimetic approach utilizing biomolecular self-assembly is described to form nanometer particle size composites for uses, such as, nonlinear optical media. Yeast tRNA was utilized as an ion-exchange/nucleation site within a polymeric matrix (polyacrylamide). Cadmium ion-exchange and subsequent sulfide precipitation resulted in formation of nanometer particle size composites. Illumination of samples with an Argon laster (514 nm) utilizing the Z-scan measurement method resulted in third order nonlinearity χ3 values of +2.7x10-6 esu.

title: Rotator angular velocity detection method and apparatus capable of removing the influence of obstacles
abstract: The invention discloses a rotator angular velocity detection method and apparatus capable of removing the influence of obstacles. The present invention employs a dual-mode multiplexed Bessel Gaussian beam with opposite azimuthal quantum numbers as a probing beam, and when it is irradiated onto a rotating body along the rotation axis, the scattered light is intensity-modulated. Through the detection of the intensity-modulated frequency, it is possible to reverse the rotation velocity of the rotating body. In addition, due to the Bessel Gaussian beam's non-diffraction characteristics, it is possible to eliminate the influence of the obstacles in an optical path. The experiment has proven that regardless of existence of obstacles in the optical path or not, the method and apparatus of the invention can accurately measure the rotation velocity of a rotating body very surely. The system of the invention is stable in structure and can be conveniently operated to realize the real time detection of the angular velocity of a rotator; and it can eliminate the influence of obstacles in the optical path to some extent, a big step forward from the prior art.

title: Single photon source based on a quantum dot molecule in an optical cavity
abstract: A solid-state device for generating a single photon for quantum information processing, the device including: a quantum dot molecule including: a first singly-charged quantum dot; and a second singly-charged quantum dot; wherein the first singly-charged quantum dot is adjacent to the second singly-charged quantum dot; and a tunnel barrier that separates the first singly-charged quantum dot from the second singly-charged quantum dot.

title: Method and device for preparing system test state based on equivalent particle characteristics and medium
abstract: The invention provides a method and device for preparing a system test state based on equivalent particle characteristics and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: determining a system, and the number of orbits and the number of electrons of the system; on the basis of equivalent particle characteristics, according to the orbital number and the electron number of the system, determining the number of excitation items included in the Fermi-form cluster operator of the system and coefficients corresponding to the excitation items; calculating a Fermi-form cluster operator of the system according to the number of the excitation items and coefficients corresponding to the excitation items; and solving the test state of the system based on the Fermi-form cluster operator of the system. The invention belongs to the field of quantum computing, solves the technical problem that complex molecules are difficult to simulate in the prior art, saves computing resources, and improves the simulation efficiency of the complex molecules.

title: Nanostructured thermoelectric materials and devices
abstract: Quantum-dot superlattice (QLSL) structures having improved thermoelectric properties are described. In one embodiment, PbSexTe1-x/PbTe QDSLs are provided having enhanced values of Seebeck coefficient and thermoelectric figure of merit (ZT) relative to bulk values. The structures can be combined into multi-chip devices to provide additional thermoelectric performance.

title: USE OF ATOMIC QUANTUM CLUSTERS (AQC) AS ANTIMICROBIAL AGENTS AND BIOCIDES
abstract: The invention relates to the use of stable atomic quantum clusters (AQC) with antimicrobial activity. The stable AQCs include at least 500 metal atoms (Mn, n<500), the metals being selected from among Au, Ag, Co, Cu, Pt, Fe, Cr, Pd, Ni, Rh, Pb or bi- or multi-metallic combinations thereof. Said AQCs are used as antimicrobial agents, antifungal agents and biocides at concentrations of the order of between 1 nM and 100 nM or more in relation to atoms of the corresponding metal. The antimicrobial activity is specific to both the type of metal and size of cluster used.

title: A SYSTEM TO STRENGTHEN QUANTUM CRYPTOGRAPHY SECURITY
abstract: In quantum key distribution, one conservatively assumes that the eavesdropper Eve is restricted only by physical laws, whereas the legitimate parties, namely the sender Alice and receiver Bob, are subject to realistic constraints, such as noise due to environment-induced decoherence. In practice, Eve too may be bound by the limits imposed by noise, which can give rise to the possibility that decoherence works to the advantage of the legitimate parties. A particular scenario of this type is one where Eve can’t replace the noisy communication channel with an ideal one, but her eavesdropping channel itself remains noiseless. Here, we point out such a situation, where the security of the ping–pong protocol (modified to a key distribution scheme) against a noise-restricted adversary improves under a non-unital noisy channel but deteriorates under unital channels. This highlights the surprising fact that, contrary to the conventional expectation, noise can be helpful to quantum information processing. Furthermore, we point out that the measurement outcome data in the context of the non-unital channel can’t be simulated by classical noise locally added by the legitimate users.

title: A light guide panel comprising quantum dot
abstract: The present invention relates to a light guide plate including a quantum dot. The quantum dot is inserted into a nanohole array of the light guide plate including the nanohole array. The light guide plate according to the present invention has a very excellent photonic crystal effect and a very excellent plasmonic effect.

title: INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD FOR QUANTUM KEY DISTRIBUTION, AND COMPUTER-READABLE MEDIUM
abstract: According to one arrangement, an information processing method includes a monitoring step (S101) and a key provision step. The monitoring step includes monitoring an operation state of an information processing device including a key generating unit that generates key information shared among a plurality of devices using a quantum key distribution technique. The key provision step includes providing the generated key information when the operation state satisfies a predetermined condition and stopping (S103) the provision of the generated key information when the operation state does not satisfy the condition.

title: QUANTUM DOT BASED OPTOELECTRONIC DEVICE AND METHOD OF MAKING SAME
abstract: A method of forming an optically active region on a silicon substrate includes the steps of epitaxially growing a silicon buffer layer on the silicon substrate and epitaxially growing a SiGe cladding layer having a plurality of arrays of quantum dots disposed therein, the quantum dots being formed from a compound semiconductor material having a lattice mismatch with the silicon buffer layer. The optically active region may be incorporated into devices such as light emitting diodes, laser diodes, and photodetectors.

title: Method of depositing nanometre scale particles
abstract: Nanometre scale particles (3) e.g. of Au are deposited on a Si substrate (2) with a SiO2 surface layer (1) provided with receptor sites (4) of a first electrical polarity by treatment with APTMS solution. The Au particles (3) have a surface charge (5) of a second opposite polarity e.g from surface adsorbed citrate ions, such that they are attracted to the surface sites on the substrate. The deposited Au particles are then released from the surface sites such that the particles move over the substrate and coalesce into a low dimensional aggregated structure. The aggregated structure may form at a surface irregularity on the surface of the substrate. The structure may be used in a quantum electronic device such as a single electron transistor. <IMAGE>

title: Chiral orbital angular momentum emitter on photonic integrated chip
abstract: A chiral orbital angular momentum emitter on a photonic integrated chip comprises a spiral waveguide set with a single-arm spiral section and single-mode bent waveguides, the spiral waveguide set composed of 12 single-mode waveguides is located at the depth of 170 micrometers, and the single-mode bent waveguides are located on the side faces of the spiral waveguide set at the same depth. The time reversal symmetry is realized by breaking chirality, and the intrinsic mode of the OAM waveguide is more local and non-degenerate, so that a specific orbital angular momentum light beam is excited, the orbital angular momentum light beam with specific chirality and specific order can be generated on a chip, high-capacity communication and high-dimensional quantum information processing of the vector vortex light beam in the photon chip are realized.

title: Mid-infrared superconducting nanowire single-photon detector
abstract: The invention discloses a mid-infrared superconducting nanowire single-photon detector. An amorphous or polycrystalline superconducting thin film containing Mo and Si is prepared into a superconducting nanowire to serve as a photosensitive surface of the detector by adopting an electron beam photoetching technology and a reactive ion etching technology, so that effective preparation of a mid-infrared SNSPD is realized; a mid-infrared light source, an adjustable attenuator, a collimator, a band-pass filter, a dilution refrigerator, a photosensitive surface, a bias device, an amplifier and a counter are adopted to form a detector, and a free space coupling technology is adopted, so that the problem of optical fiber coupling mid-infrared SNSPD is effectively solved; photons of the mid-infrared band are emitted and received, the number of photons reaching the photosensitive surface in unit time is calculated, and a foundation is laid for effectively calculating the quantum detection efficiency of the mid-infrared SNSPD.

title: Compound containing benzimidazole and application of compound to organic electroluminescent device
abstract: The invention discloses a benzimidazole compound and application of the compound to an organic electroluminescent device. With benzimidazole ring as the core, the compound has characteristics of no easy crystallization or aggregation among molecules and good film forming ability. When the compound is used as a luminescent layer main-body material of an OLED luminescent device, current efficiency, power efficiency and external quantum efficiency of the device are all greatly improved. Meanwhile, life of the device is obviously prolonged.

title: ELECTRON TRANSPORT GATE CIRCUITS AND METHODS OF MANUFACTURE, OPERATION AND USE
abstract: A circuit is disclosed that includes a first electrode, a second electrode and a plurality of quantum dot devices disposed between the first electrode and the second electrode. An impedance is coupled to the second electrode and has a value selected to conduct or block conduction of current when a coherent electron conduction band is formed by one or more of the quantum dot devices, such as with quantum dot devices in an adjacent circuit.

title: Data processing method, machine learning framework and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a data processing method, a machine learning framework and related equipment. The method comprises the steps of calling a quantum module and a classic module to create a machine learning model comprising a quantum program, calling a data structure module to obtain target data and creating tensor data comprising the target data; the calling quantum module divides second quantum bits into multiple groups based on the number of the first quantum bits required by the quantum program and the number of the second quantum bits allowed to be used in the quantum device; invoking a quantum module to generate, for each set of second qubits, a quantum line including the set of second qubits based on a quantum program; and obtaining input data of each group of quantum circuits based on the tensor data, and inputting the input data into each quantum circuit to obtain an output result of each quantum circuit. A plurality of quantum circuits are generated according to a quantum program and are used for processing input data, so that the operation efficiency of the data is improved.

title: NEAR-FIELD OPTICAL DEVICE, RECORDING DEVICE AND SAMPLE SUBSTRATE
abstract: A near-field optical device (100) is provided with a quantum dots (113, 116) that generate near-field light on the basis of light emitted from outside, and an output end (118) that is capable of outputting at least some energy from the near-field light that is generated to the outside. The output end is formed in such a manner that the length in one direction, as viewed in a plane from above the output end, is longer than the length in another direction that intersects said one direction. The near-field optical device enables information to be appropriately recorded by heat-assisted magnetic recording.

title: MULTIMODE COUPLER TO CONTROL INTERACTION BETWEEN QUANTUM BITS
abstract: A device comprises first and second superconducting quantum bits, and a multimode coupler circuit coupled between the first and second superconducting quantum bits. The multimode coupler circuit comprises a first mode and a second mode, and is configured to operate in one of a first state and a second state, in response to a flux tuning control signal. In the first state, the first superconducting quantum bit is exchange coupled to the first mode, and the second superconducting quantum bit is exchange coupled to the second mode, to suppress interaction between the first and second superconducting quantum bits. In the second state, the first and second superconducting quantum bits are exchange coupled to both the first and second modes, to enable an interaction between the first and second superconducting quantum bits and perform an entanglement gate operation.

title: OPTICAL SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICE
abstract: PURPOSE: To provide an optical semiconductor device such as a light emitting diode, a semiconductor laser, a surface light emission type semiconductor laser, etc., having narrow light emitting spectral width and high light emitting efficiency. CONSTITUTION: An active layer is formed of a plurality of quantum wires QW, which has a structure having at least one adjacent wire QW in which carrier can be tunneled, the carrier generated by current injection or light exciting is sequentially tunneled to the wiring QW having relatively lower energy, a light is emitted from the wire QW having relatively low energy to obtain a light emission having narrow light emitting spectral width. The wiring can be replaced by a quantum box. Since the tunneling speed of the carrier is low at the low temperature, the light emitting spectral width is wide, but at the ambient temperature, the tunneling speed of the carrier is large, and hence the light is emitted at the wiring having low energy, and the spectral width is narrowed.

title: Bluetooth communication method and system for realizing end-to-end voice encryption and Bluetooth equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a Bluetooth communication scheme for end-to-end voice encryption, which enables a Bluetooth device to perform identity authentication operation in the use period in a one-certificate one-password mode, and can improve the communication security in an efficient and reliable mode. The secret keys used for encryption conversation are generated according to needs, instantaneity is high, use is safer, quantum secret keys with true randomness are adopted as communication voice secret keys and authentication secret keys, and a high-safety end-to-end voice encryption transmission system can be achieved in cooperation with a national secret standard algorithm. And the communication voice data are all ciphertexts in transmission links except the Bluetooth device, so that the security is greatly improved. The encryption communication function can be realized only by configuring an application program in the communication equipment, the mobile phone number of a user and an address book contact do not need to be changed, the switching of an encryption/common call mode is realized through simple operation under the condition that the Bluetooth equipment is allowed to be connected, the use can be effectively simplified, the operation experience is improved, and the user experience is improved. And meanwhile, any hardware change on the communication equipment is not needed.

title: Quantum distribution network debugging system based on message tracking
abstract: The invention discloses a quantum distribution network debugging system based on message tracking. The system comprises a QNDCS and a plurality of quantum device network nodes. The QNDCS is provided with a session establishment module, an edge weight calculation module, an optimal path module, a routing table information sending module, a message transmission module, a marking module and a time difference calculation module; the session establishment module establishes session connection of the quantum device network nodes; an edge weight calculation module calculates the weight of the edge of the adjacent network node; the optimal path module calculates an optimal path between the network nodes; the routing table information sending module sends routing table information; the marking module marks the time when the network node session is established and disconnected; the time difference calculation module calculates a time difference between session establishment and session disconnection. According to the invention, the data transmission is realized by establishing the connection topology graph of the central server QNDCS and the nodes and calculating the optimal path, the throughput of the system is reduced, and the secure communication of the quantum network nodes is realized.

title: ALL-SEMICONDUCTOR JOSEPHSON JUNCTION DEVICE FOR QUBIT APPLICATIONS
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a quantum mechanical device includes a monolithic crystalline structure. The monolithic crystalline structure includes a first region doped to provide a first superconducting region, and a second region doped to provide a second superconducting region, the second superconducting region being separated from the first superconducting region by an undoped crystalline region. The first and second superconducting regions and the undoped crystalline region form a Josephson junction.

title: Display device for improving internal quantum efficiency
abstract: A display device includes a substrate, a first light-emitting element, a second light-emitting element, and a third light-emitting element on the substrate, each of the first, second, and third light-emitting elements includes a first semiconductor layer, an active layer, a second semiconductor layer, and a third semiconductor layer, an opening formed in the second semiconductor layer and the third semiconductor layer of the third light-emitting element, and a wavelength conversion member located at the opening, wherein the first light-emitting element and the third light-emitting element are configured to emit first light, and the second light-emitting element is configured to emit second light, and the wavelength conversion member is configured to convert the first light from the third light-emitting element into third light.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for measuring quantum efficiency of image sensor
abstract: The invention provides a method for measuring the quantum efficiency of an image sensor. The method comprises the steps that the image sensor receives a continuous spectrum from a light source through an optical fiber panel; the image sensor obtains an image at an interval of unit integral time under dark field and exposure conditions to obtain a dark field image group and an exposure image group; subtracting the pixel value of the dark field image group from the pixel value of the exposure image group to obtain a data difference value of unit integral time; acquiring an image of the continuous spectrum filtered by a plurality of specific wavelengths, and positioning a specific position of the specific wavelength in the continuous spectrum through an image sensor; fitting to obtain an optical power curve and obtain an optical power value of the first wavelength through the specific position, the continuous spectrum and the corresponding relation between the continuous spectrum and the optical power; and calculating the quantum efficiency of the image sensor corresponding to the first wavelength according to the optical power value, the first wavelength, the pixel size, the unit integration time, the data difference value and the conversion gain, and the method is used for accurately measuring the quantum efficiency of the image sensor.

title: CRYPTOGRAPHIC DATA VERIFICATION METHOD
abstract: The invention relates to a comparison method implemented by at least one apparatus (A; B), between a first and a second dataset, in particular with a view to determining whether these two datasets are identical, this method not requiring the presence of these two datasets on the apparatus, and comprising the following steps: a) mixing a number, referred to as the mixing number, with the first dataset, using a mixing function (105; 405), in order to obtain mixed data, b) hashing the mixed data using a hash function (106); 406), and c) comparing the hash thus obtained in step b) with a third dataset assumed to be the hash of the second dataset mixed with the same mixing number as that used in step a) and with the same mixing function (105; 405).

title: JOSEPHSON CURRENT SOURCE SYSTEMS AND METHOD
abstract: One embodiment describes a Josephson current source system (14). The system includes a flux-shuttle loop (16) that is inductively coupled with an AC input signal. The flux-shuttle loop includes a plurality of Josephson junctions spaced about the flux-shuttle loop and being configured, when activated, to sequentially trigger the plurality of Josephson junctions about the flux-shuttle loop in response to the AC input signal to generate a DC output current provided through an output inductor. The system also includes a flux injector (18) that is configured to selectively activate and deactivate the flux-shuttle loop in response to an input signal to control an amplitude of the DC output current.

title: Quantum echo state network model construction method for aero-engine fault early warning
abstract: A quantum echo state network model construction method for aero-engine fault early warning comprises the steps that firstly, time sequence data of an aero-engine is quantized; then, taking the quantum state data as the input of a first-layer quantum network, obtaining probabilistic output through quantum measurement after the quantum state data is subjected to the action of a quantum recursive line, and transmitting the probabilistic output to a reservoir of a second-layer echo state network to obtain a high-dimensional intermediate state; and finally, an output layer weight matrix can be obtained through one-time calculation by using a least square method, and network training is completed. And the trained quantum echo state network model is applied to aero-engine fault prediction, and engine operation state prediction data with relatively high accuracy at future moments are given. An entangled state is realized by using a quantum controlled NOT gate, a possible coupling relationship between original input data is approximately represented, and a quantum revolving gate is set as an adjustable parameter of a first layer of quantum network, so that data distribution can be adjusted; and the echo state network layer can play the calculation advantages of fast calculation and completion of the final model through one-step training.

title: Method for increasing quantum entanglement quantum repeating method and quantum repeater using thereof
abstract: PURPOSE: A method for increasing quantum entanglement, a quantum relay method using the same, and a quantum relay are provided to solve a problem which does not uses quantum communication by easily reducing quantum entanglement due to incomplete measurement. CONSTITUTION: Two input signals of a quantum state are inputted(110). In case a background noise is in a non-Markovian type(120), the background noise is converted in a Markovian type(130). Both entanglement distillation is performed from the converted background noise and the inputted input signal(150). Time difference between a source input signal and a target input signal is delayed as ESD(Entanglement Sudden Death) generation time. [Reference numerals] (110) Receiving two input signals of a quantum state; (120) Determining a type of background noise; (130) Converting background noise into a Markovian type by delaying one of two input signals as predetermined time when the back ground noise is a non-Markovian type; (140) Calculating a Pauli channel for back ground noise of a Markovian type and mixing predetermined other noise and background noise by using the calculated Pauli channel; (150) Extracting quantum entanglement from an input signal and background noise of a converted Markovian type; (AA) Start; (BB) End

title: THIN FILM SPIN PROBE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately/easily measure a parallel/vertical spin polarizing component in the sample surface by forming a thin film to support an active probe area on a substrate, and removing a prescribed place of the substrate by selective etching after also forming a thin film of an active probe area on the thin film. SOLUTION: A thin film 2 of AlGaAs is formed on a substrate 1, and a thin film 3 of GaAs is also formed on it. The thin film 2 of AlGaAs is transparent to the exciting light, and has a support function to support an active probe area. The thin film 3 of GaAs is an active probe area, has a shutting-in function of a light exciting carrier, and is composed of a quantum structure of a quantum well/multiple quantum well structure. A thin film spin probe is formed by cleaving the center of the residual thin film part in two directions by removing a part 4 of a substrate 1 of a probe material by selective etching by using an alkali etchant after forming thin films of two layers on the substrate 1.

title: Mobile secure communication method based on quantum key distribution network
abstract: The invention discloses a mobile secure communication method based on a quantum key distribution network, and solves the security and efficiency problems of a quantum key relay and a mobile application thereof. The method comprises the steps that enabling a mobile terminal to apply for registration to quantum nodes, obtain quantum key flow and create a service association list; enabling the quantum network management server to query the associated calling quantum node and called quantum node according to the request; obtaining an optimal node for providing the service according to the stored relay routing table and the current state of the related quantum node, enabling the calling quantum node and the called quantum node to relay the sub-keys of the corresponding mobile terminal to the node respectively, and enabling the node to send the exclusive-OR values of the two sub-keys to the mobile terminal; and enabling the mobile terminal to perform corresponding analysis and takes one of the sub-keys as a shared session key. The method has very important practical application value in the fields of network security systems of mobile communication, mobile office, industrial control (finance, electric power, energy, traffic and the like) and the like.

title: Anode with surface quantum state and semiconductor device
abstract: The invention discloses an anode with a surface quantum state and a semiconductor device, and relates to the technical field of organic semiconductor optoelectronic devices. The anode with the surface quantum state is applied to the semiconductor device and comprises a substrate, a conductive anode and a surface quantum state generation area which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top. According to the invention, the charge transfer quantum state on the surface of the anode is utilized to directly inject the hole into the HOMO energy level of the hole transport layer, so that the performance of the semiconductor device can be improved.

title: Digital audio signal encryption/decryption method based on quanta
abstract: The invention relates to a digital audio signal encryption/decryption method based on quanta. The method aims to protect audio information. The audio information encryption process comprises the steps that quantum state representation of audio data is achieved firstly, then two secret keys are utilized to process audio digital signals in a space domain and a quantum Fourier transformation domain respectively, and quantum audio encryption data are obtained. The reversibility of quantum calculation is utilized in the audio information decryption stage, and the decryption process is inverse processing on the encryption process. The theoretical analysis of the simulation result shows that compared with a double-random-phase encoding encryption technology based on classics, the method has the advantages of being lower in time domain correlation and frequency domain correlation of the encrypted audio data, stronger in robustness and lower in calculation complexity. In addition, audio data encryption based on the quanta is achieved, and the application range of multimedia data in the quantum field is expanded.

title: Multilayer polymer-quantum dot light emitting diodes and methods of making and using thereof
abstract: Disclosed herein are multilayer polymer-quantum dot light emitting diodes (PQD-LEDs) and methods of making thereof. As disclosed, the PQD-LEDs comprise at least one quantum dot layer made from an aqueous suspension of quantum dots upon which a polymer layer is deposited by spin coating methods known in the art. The quantum dot layers and the polymer layers are discrete and distinct from one another. Also disclosed are methods of making the PQD-LEDs of the present invention and kits.

title: QUANTUM INJECTION SYSTEM
abstract: A system is disclosed comprising a package of active Fabry-Perot transmitters and an electric charge accumulator for converting a part of coherent electromagnetic power in electric power at the proper voltage of this accumulator. An active Fabry-Perot transmitter is a semiconductor device comprising a packet of p-i-n diodes with double quantum dots on the two sides of the i-layer, separated by potential barriers from the conduction regions. The semiconductor structure is placed in a Fabry-Perot cavity with total transmission. While a resonant coherent electromagnetic beam is crossing the Fabry-Perot cavity, a small part from the electromagnetic energy is captured by resonant electron excitations through the i-layer, injecting an electron current in the device.

title: Model simulation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a model simulation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. According to the scheme, on the basis of model parameters of a to-be-simulated model, a wave function corresponding to each electron in the to-be-simulated model is obtained, and the to-be-simulated model is a semiconductor quantum chip model; for a first electron and a second electron in the to-be-simulated model, determining target data associated with the first electron and the second electron according to a wave function corresponding to the first electron and a dielectric constant of a first position where the first electron is located; according to the target data and the wave function corresponding to the first electron, determining a target coefficient of coulomb interaction between the first electron and the second electron; and adjusting model parameters based on the target coefficient. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the target coefficient of coulomb interaction between electrons is determined in the simulation process of the semiconductor quantum chip model, so that simulation of the semiconductor quantum chip model is realized based on the target coefficient.

title: Broad-spectrum white-light LED structure and growing method
abstract: The invention provides a broad-spectrum white-light LED structure. A GaN buffer layer and a GaN support layer are arranged on a sapphire substrate or a silicon substrate, wherein the thickness of the GaN support layer is over 50 to 2,000nm; and the thickness of an N type GaN is 20 to 1,000nm, and the concentration of the N type GaN is 5*1,018cm-1. A blue light wavelength quantum well material, a blue-green or green quantum well material and a reddish yellow light or red light quantum well material are sequentially grown on the N type GaN, wherein a blue light quantum well is of an InxGa1-xN/GaN multi-quantum well structure of 1 to 10 periods, which is 2 to 20nm and 4 to 25nm thick respectively, and the x is between 0.1 and 0.18; the green light quantum well is of the InxGa1-xN/GaN multi-quantum well structure of 1 to 10 periods, which is 2 to 20nm and 4 to 25nm thick respectively, and the x is between 0.18 and 0.32; and the reddish yellow light or red light quantum well is of the InxGa1-xN/GaN multi-quantum well structure of 1 to 10 periods, which is 2 to 20nm and 4 to 25nm thick respectively, and the x is over 0.32. A three-color GaN substrate white-light LED structure is obtained by the invention.

title: LAYOUT CONSTRUCTION METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR SEMICONDUCTOR QUBIT LAYOUT, MEDIUM, AND DEVICE
abstract: A layout construction method and system for a semiconductor qubit layout, a medium, and a device. The layout construction method comprises: obtaining an electrode structure layer of semiconductor qubits and a plurality of ion implantation layers located on the periphery of the electrode structure layer, wherein the electrode structure layer is provided with a plurality of first electrodes and a plurality of second electrodes, and the number of the first electrodes is equal to that of the ion implantation layers (S1); determining a first limiting frame between the electrode structure layer and the plurality of ion implantation layers, and determining a second limiting frame on the peripheries of the plurality of ion implantation layers (S2); generating, on the first limiting frame, a plurality of first conductive disks corresponding to each of the first electrodes and a plurality of second conductive disks corresponding to each of the second electrodes (S3); and generating, on the second limiting frame, a plurality of first pads corresponding to each of the first conductive disks and a plurality of second pads corresponding to each of the second conductive disks (S4). By means of the solution, conductive disks and pads can be automatically drawn, thereby improving the efficiency and accuracy of layout drawing.

title: Memory element and memory device
abstract: A memory element including a memory layer to hold the information by the magnetization state of a magnetic substance, a magnetization pinned layer having magnetization serving as a reference of the information stored in the memory layer, an intermediate layer formed from a nonmagnetic substance disposed between the memory layer and the magnetization pinned layer, a magnetic coupling layer disposed adjoining the magnetization pinned layer and opposing to the intermediate layer, and a high coercive force layer disposed adjoining the magnetic coupling layer, wherein the information is stored by reversing magnetization of the memory layer, making use of spin torque magnetization reversal generated along with a current passing in the lamination direction of the layered structure including the memory layer, the intermediate layer, and the magnetization pinned layer, and the magnetic coupling layer has a two-layer laminate structure.

title: Quantum state bidirectional secure transmission method based on quantum encryption
abstract: The invention discloses a quantum state bidirectional secure transmission method based on quantum encryption. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a butterfly network model; the sending node and the control node share a six-particle maximum entanglement state; the sending node performs joint Bell base measurement and two-particle projection measurement on owned particles; the control node executes single-particle measurement on owned particles under the measurement base; the sending node transmits the classic message to the intermediate node; the intermediate node performs encoding operation on the received classic message, transmits an encoded result to the next intermediate node, and then sends the encoded result to the two target nodes; the sending nodes perform encryption operation on respective quantum states, and send the encrypted quantum states to the target node; and the target node executes corresponding decryption operation on the encrypted quantum state according to the coding result sent by the next intermediate node. According to the method, quantum invisible state transmission and remote state preparation thoughts are combined, and a quantum network coding technology is utilized, so that perfect cross secure transmission of quantum states in a butterfly network is realized.

title: A laser system comprising two phase-locked continuous-wave laser sources
abstract: A laser system 1 comprises two phase-locked solid-state laser sources 2, 3 for example, Ti: sapphire lasers may be may be continuously pumped at 532 nm sources 4, 5. The laser system 1 can be phase-locked at a predetermined offset between the operating frequencies of the lasers. This is achieved with high precision while exhibiting both low noise and high agility around the predetermined offset frequency. A pulse generator 14 can be employed to generate a series of optical pulses from the laser system, the number, duration and shape of which can all be selected by a user. A phase-lock feedback loop provides a means for predetermined frequency chirps and phase shifts to be introduced throughout a sequence of generated pulses. The laser system can be made highly automated. The above features render the laser system ideally suited for use within coherent control two state quantum systems, for example atomic interferometry, gyroscopes, precision gravimeters gravity gradiometers and quantum information processing and in particular the generation and control of quantum bits.

title: COMPUTATIONAL TEMPORAL LOGIC FOR SUPERCONDUCTING LOGIC CIRCUIT DESIGN
abstract: A primitive race-logic temporal operator is described (FA: first arrived Is: Inhibit, Dc: Add Constant, La: Last arrived, C: coincidence), comprising superconducting logic single flux quantum (SFQ) cells.

title: Quantum communication networking method and system based on multi-wavelength entangled light source
abstract: The invention discloses a quantum communication networking method and system based on a multi-wavelength entangled light source. The method comprises the steps: by a multi-wavelength entangled light source, generating entangled single photons which are equal in frequency interval and paired; performing wavelength channel configuration on the entangled single photons by using a relatively mature dense wavelength division multiplexing technology in a classical optical fiber communication system; and constructing a quantum network server independent of the users and distributing the entangled photons of each wavelength to each user, thereby ensuring that every two users can share a pair of independent entangled single photons, and finally realizing a quantum communication network in which multiple users are randomly interconnected.
